jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Zencore is a fast-growing company founded by former Google Cloud leaders, architects, and engineers. We are seeking candidates with significant experience in Google Cloud to join our team. Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. We embed within customer teams to provide strategic guidance, facilitate technology decisions, and execute projects in a collaborative, co-development style.

What You Will Do

As a Project Manager, you will lead and manage the successful delivery of engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services, like Google Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, BigQuery, Anthos, and our AI/Machine Learning capabilities.

In this role, you will regularly engage with diverse stakeholder groups, including executives of large enterprises and a cross-functional and geographically dispersed team within Google to help gather requirements, scope engagements, plan, and deliver service offerings to accelerate the cloud adoption journey. You will utilize your relationship management, leadership skills, and technical background to lead others, proactively mitigate risks, resolve issues, and advance projects when appropriate effectively communicate at all levels of the organization.

What We Need

Customer-facing experience, interfacing with executive stakeholders, driving/managing/delivering IT technical implementations, transformation programs, or other initiatives
Experience supporting enterprise customers in one of the following: Cloud Professional Services organizations, comparable IT consulting, or program management organizations
A history of mentoring and or teaching others to use process, organization, change, and/or learning improvement methodologies
Ability to create and run measurement systems to track adoption, utilization, and proficiency of individual changesIdentify resistance and performance gaps, and work to develop and implement corrective actions.
Work with project teams to integrate change management activities into overall project plansAdaptable self-starter who is skilled at creating structure in ambiguous environments
Strong logical and analytical problem-solving skills; rigorous approach to project management to deliver enterprise-level projects
Comfortable with being on video in meetings internally and with clients

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration field or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in value consulting, proposal development, and execution with public cloud providers like Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Why Work Here

We are professionals you can Trust.
Our people have the extensive experience to get the job done We share unbiased opinions and are comfortable with the hard truths.
You are the subject matter experts for our customers. We are the Missing Link. You will connect our customers to Google and move quickly when others can’t
We remove uncertainty and risk by clearly outlining the process of cloud migration for our customers
We accelerate timelines and do not dwell on a challenge.
You’ll move faster and expose “unknown unknowns” for our customers
We show empathy. Our customers believe in us because we can relate to their complexities

How To Succeed

First rule at Zencore - Be Kind
Own the process - own your customer’s success by proactive practices
Work hard to reach the destination, but make sure to enjoy the journey
Champion a consistent collaborative culture
Be receptive to FeedbackChallenge the Status Quo

We are a fully remote company and offer competitive compensation and benefits .

Zencore is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Zencore is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Description
Position Type:
Full-Time
Location:
Remote
Working Hours:
U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
We are looking for an exceptionally organized and process-driven Project Manager
to manage commercial and industrial ERRCS (Emergency Responder Radio Coverage Systems) projects from bid through final closeout. You will coordinate project documentation, construction requirements, contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). You will manage multiple projects simultaneously, track deadlines and requirements, prepare and submit documentation, and ensure each project progresses smoothly from quote through completion. This role is ideal for someone with U.S. commercial construction project management experience
who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with construction documents, permits, contractors, and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Pre-Contract & Estimating
Review and log incoming bid requests in the project management/CRM system.
Review construction plans, drawings, specifications, and project manuals.
Research and document project requirements, including construction type, square footage, stories, taxes, warranties, maintenance agreements, insurance, bonds, and other requirements.
Research local AHJ requirements, fire codes, ERRCS policies, radio systems, frequencies, and permit requirements.
Coordinate with AHJs to confirm enforcement, testing, plan review, permitting, and inspection requirements.
Research contractor licensing and registration requirements.
Support budgetary pricing and prepare project quotes.
Maintain accurate project information and documentation in CRM and shared systems.

Contract Award & Vendor Coordination
Review contracts and identify unusual or inconsistent requirements.
Coordinate RFQs with RF engineers, installers, equipment distributors, and other vendors.
Review system designs, vendor quotes, and Bills of Materials for accuracy and completeness.
Coordinate pricing for equipment, electrical, fire alarm, roofing, and other project requirements.
Track sales tax, shipping, warranties, maintenance agreements, and other project costs.
Maintain executed contracts and project records.

Pre-Installation Documentation
Prepare, format, organize, and distribute project submittals to customers, installers, and AHJs.
Coordinate building plans, certifications, permits, equipment documentation, system designs, reports, and trade coordination documents.
Prepare and maintain installer work orders and project documentation.
Collect and verify vendor W-9s, COIs, OSHA certifications, and other required credentials.
Coordinate customer-specific requirements such as insurance, background checks, drug testing, badging, and certifications.
Confirm project and contractor licensing or permit requirements.

AHJ & Permit Coordination
Submit project documentation to AHJs for formal plan review when required.
Coordinate BDA transmission requests with applicable radio system administrators.
Apply for required fire or building permits.
Track plan reviews, radio approvals, permits, and inspections.
Follow up with AHJs and relevant authorities to keep approvals moving.
Maintain accurate records of regulatory and permitting requirements.

Installation & Project Coordination
Coordinate with technical services, installers, trades, customers, and vendors throughout the project.
Track equipment orders and delivery schedules.
Coordinate responses to changes in building plans, construction timelines, and project requirements.
Follow up on outstanding tasks, approvals, documents, and deliverables.
Maintain project timelines and ensure stakeholders remain informed.
Identify and resolve project issues before they impact deadlines.

Post-Installation & Closeout
Prepare and distribute final project closeout documentation.
Maintain system manuals and post-installation documentation.
Coordinate commissioning reports, signal test reports, warranties, installation photos, and as-built system designs.
Confirm completion of installer and trade coordination requirements.
Coordinate project invoicing and supporting documentation.
Follow up on lien waivers from installers and suppliers when required.
Ensure projects are fully documented and properly closed.

Process Improvement & Automation
Maintain and improve standardized project management processes, templates, and systems.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve project workflows.
Build and maintain organized documentation systems.
Support automation initiatives to improve project tracking, reporting, and communication.
Continuously identify ways to improve efficiency and accountability.

Required Experience & Skills
Proven experience managing commercial or industrial construction projects
.
Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, contractors, and resources simultaneously.
Strong understanding of U.S. construction project workflows.
Familiarity with International Building Code (IBC) and International Fire Code (IFC)
.
Strong project documentation and coordination experience.
Experience working with contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and regulatory authorities.
Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.
Strong experience with project management systems and/or CRM platforms.
Excellent professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Exceptional organization, follow-up, and attention to detail.
Strong ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
Self-starter with the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
Continuous-improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ERRCS, PS-DAS, BDA, RF systems, fire alarm systems, or public safety communications
.
Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud
, or similar construction management platforms.
Experience coordinating with Fire Departments, Building Departments, Fire Marshals, Building Inspectors, or other AHJs.
Experience with construction permitting and plan review processes.
Experience working with U.S.-based commercial construction companies.

Typical Day
A typical day may include reviewing new bid requests, researching project and AHJ requirements, updating project records, following up with contractors and vendors, coordinating RFQs and submittals, tracking permits and approvals, reviewing project documentation, communicating with customers, and updating project timelines and action items.

is responsible for leading and managing the company’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) contracts within EPA Region 6 and other regions and ensuring all projects are executed in alignment with client expectations, contractual requirements, and company objectives. The Program Manager II also plays a key role in mentoring and developing staff, including program and project managers, to ensure consistent and successful project delivery.

The Program Manager II has the potential to work fully remotely with occasional travel to project sites and HGL offices. Preference is for candidates who reside within EPA Region 6 (Arkansas, Louisiana, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Texas).

Program and Staff Management:

Support the EPA program and direct all EPA-related contracts and CLIN (Contract Line-Item Number) project managers within the region.
Manage and support a team of staff , including formal employee mentorship to provide guidance and professional development.
Communicate and connect with various departments (proposal development, contracts, chemistry, data management, etc.) to ensure that they are properly coordinating and functioning to support the region.

Project Oversight And Delivery

Ensure EPA projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with project scope of work and contract requirements and client expectations.
Conduct routine meetings with project managers to monitor project progress, review deliverables, and provide strategic direction.
Guide and enforce company best practices for consistent EPA project execution across teams.
Address and resolve project issues and challenges, including navigating complex client and team dynamics.
Serve as a Senior Project Manager.
Uphold contract and company required QA/QC and Health and Safety standards.

Client And Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as the liaison with EPA clients , fostering strong relationships to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
Coordinate with external stakeholders for scope and cost sensitive items including EPA clients and state and local agencies as needed for specific projects.
Respond to client inquiries and proactively address client needs to maintain high levels of satisfaction.

Proposal And Business Development

Organize and lead proposal efforts for EPA-related opportunities, working closely with technical teams, HGL leadership, and teaming partners to submit high-quality and competitive proposals.
Assist in growing the company’s EPA portfolio , identifying new opportunities, and contributing to long-term client engagement strategies.
Evaluate potential project opportunities for profitability and alignment with company goals.
Support planning for and attendance of client sponsored Industry Day events and conferences.

Process Improvement And Standardization

Utilize approved digital and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support technical documentation, data analysis, project communications, and workflow efficiency.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills with the ability to manage complex situations and personalities.

Strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture while focusing on project details.

Project Management Processional (PMP) certification a strong plus.
Experience using Ganttic or other resource management tools is a plus.
Microsoft software, including but not limited to Microsoft Project.
Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve technical writing, data analysis, research, visualization, or project delivery efficiency.

Analyzing and synthesizing data; Complex problem solving and decision making; Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations; Writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation; Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities; Communicating effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders; Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Project Manager (Data Centers)
to join us in Houston, TX.
The following locations will also be considered: San Diego, CA, New York, NY, Houston, TX, Portland, OR and Seattle, WA
. This position can be offered remotely.

As demand for AI, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure accelerates, our clients are developing some of the world's largest, most complex, and most power-intensive facilities. In this role, you will help deliver the electrical infrastructure that enables next-generation data center campuses—projects requiring hundreds of megawatts of power and unprecedented levels of planning, engineering, and coordination. You will work across the full project lifecycle, playing a key role in delivering critical infrastructure for some of the industry's most prominent clients.

What makes this opportunity unique is the breadth of collaboration across WSP's global organization. You will work alongside top experts in their field to solve highly complex infrastructure challenges. This multidisciplinary environment provides exposure to the full range of technical and strategic considerations required to successfully develop large-scale data center campuses. You will contribute to the planning and design of substations, transmission interconnections, and site electrical infrastructure while supporting fast-paced projects that demand innovation, technical excellence, and strong collaboration.

If you're energized by large-scale infrastructure projects, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while accelerating your career on some of the most significant power delivery projects being developed today.

Provides technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of critical high-voltage infrastructure for data center projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. Tasks include responsibility for overall performance of distribution system and grid modernization projects of moderate size/complexity and/or local/regional scope. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.

Your Impact

Lead and oversee cross-functional teams delivering power distribution and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and distribution projects.
Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power & energy market.
Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for power delivery projects.
Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in all aspects of distribution design.
Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects.
Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future projects.
Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of experience managing projects in power distribution, transmission & distribution (T&D), or utility engineering environments.
Proven experience delivering feeder, distribution line, or grid modernization projects.
Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in complex utility environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
PMI Certification (PMP or CAPM).

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. Description

The Opportunity

RETTEW is seeking an experienced Water/Wastewater Engineering Project Manager to lead infrastructure projects that directly support the reliability, safety, and long-term resilience of the communities we serve.

In this role, you'll take ownership of water and wastewater projects from planning through design, permitting, and delivery. You'll manage project scope, schedule, and budget; serve as a trusted client contact; coordinate multidisciplinary teams; and help develop the engineers working alongside you.

You'll have the autonomy to lead your projects while still having access to experienced technical professionals, Project Managers, and leadership when complex challenges arise. As a 100% employee-owned company, successful project delivery, strong client relationships, and sustainable growth directly contribute to the company we collectively own.

What You'll Do

As a Water/Wastewater Engineering Project Manager, you will:

Manage drinking water and wastewater infrastructure projects from planning and design through permitting, bidding, and delivery.
Take responsibility for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for municipal, authority, and other water/wastewater clients.
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams, including engineering, environmental, permitting, and field professionals.
Support the planning and design of drinking water and wastewater systems, including treatment facilities, distribution and collection systems, pump stations, system upgrades, rehabilitation, and related infrastructure.
Develop and review engineering plans, technical reports, specifications, permit applications, and other project deliverables.
Evaluate existing infrastructure and help clients develop practical solutions to improve system performance, reliability, and long-term needs.
Coordinate permitting and regulatory requirements with clients and applicable agencies.
Lead or support construction-phase services, including submittal reviews, RFIs, contractor coordination, and resolution of field issues.
Identify project risks, changing conditions, and scope needs early and work with clients and internal teams to develop solutions.
Mentor and provide project guidance to junior engineers and technical staff.
Support proposals, project pursuits, and opportunities to expand relationships with existing clients in partnership with RETTEW's Business Development resources.

What We're Looking For

Required

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Active Professional Engineer (PE) license, with Pennsylvania licensure or eligibility to obtain Pennsylvania licensure through reciprocity.
Professional experience delivering drinking water and/or wastewater infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated project-management experience with responsibility for scope, schedule, and budget.
Experience coordinating engineering teams and project deliverables.
Strong client-facing communication skills and experience building productive professional relationships.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects while maintaining quality and client expectations.

Preferred

Experience working in an engineering consulting environment.
Experience managing municipal or authority water/wastewater projects.
Knowledge of Pennsylvania water/wastewater regulations and permitting requirements.
Experience with treatment, distribution, collection, pumping, rehabilitation, or other municipal water/wastewater infrastructure.
Experience mentoring or providing project leadership to engineers and technical staff.
Experience contributing to proposals, client development, or expansion of existing client relationships.

Why RETTEW

At RETTEW, Project Managers have the opportunity to own their projects—not simply support them.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead meaningful infrastructure projects that directly affect the communities our clients serve.
Build lasting relationships with municipal and water/wastewater clients.
Work across a variety of project types rather than being limited to one narrow area of water/wastewater engineering.
Develop engineers and emerging project leaders while continuing to grow your own leadership skills.
Collaborate with experienced technical professionals across disciplines when projects require additional expertise.
Partner with Business Development resources to grow client relationships without carrying that responsibility alone.
Continue developing toward larger project, client, and leadership responsibilities.
Work in a flexible hybrid environment that supports both collaboration and focused work.

RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned company. Through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), eligible employees have the opportunity to build ownership in the company and share in the long-term value we create together.

Our employee-owners are encouraged to think beyond individual assignments—to build strong client relationships, deliver excellent work, improve how we operate, and contribute to the long-term success of the company.

Workplace Designation: Hybrid
Locations: Lancaster, PA | State College, PA |Mechanicsburg, PA

This role combines in-office collaboration, remote work, client interaction, and project-related travel as needed. Collaboration with professionals across RETTEW offices and disciplines is expected to support project delivery, client needs, and resource sharing.

RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned engineering consulting firm that has been helping clients solve complex challenges since 1969. Built on a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we empower our employee-owners to grow their careers while delivering meaningful results for our clients.

Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. Job Description

Position Summary

The Sr. Program Manager is responsible for the successful initiation, execution, and monitoring of any Sirtex corporate programs including NPI, NPD, commercial launch, clinical, and post market surveillance. This role will be responsible for multiple cross-functional streams of work, identification, and resolution of program-level issues and the mitigation of risks where they pose a significant threat to success, always with a focus on delivering value to the business in a timely manner. The role requires an individual who has proven commercial product launch, clinical study and post market surveillance experience.

Responsible for planning and execution of commercial launch of a Sirtex product or acquired product via Business Development
Responsible for post market projects to ensure Quality, Safety, and compliance of Sirtex products through Quality management system, with a focus on Design Control and Post-Market processes
Responsible for monitoring key clinical studies and reporting to senior management and shareholders

Coordinate activities between operational and commercial organizations from project initiation through launch
Maintains effective communication with senior management, providing awareness of critical issues and action plans for resolution of issues

Ability to anticipate areas of difficulty/potential unknown risks, contribute towards creative solutions and moves to action quickly

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in health sciences, health administration, biomedical, engineering, or related field required. Strong preference for Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Biomedical Engineering

5+ years’ experience of commercial product launch as a project lead or program manager in medical device or pharmaceutical industry required

3+ years’ experience of clinical study program management
3+ years’ experience of post market program management
5+ years of proven experience in program management with an emphasis on project planning, scope/schedule control, problem solving, risk mitigation, communications
Project Manager Professional (PMP) certificate preferred
Demonstrated project management, consulting, process flow development and facilitation skills.
Ability to successfully perform in a matrix accountability structure, reporting the progress of deliverables and project updates to senior leadership team
Proficient communications skill (oral, written and presentation) with the ability to communicate effectively through all levels of the organization
Strong computer skills including knowledge of MS Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Excellent engagement, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to unite those with various perspectives towards a shared vision
Excellent organizational skills with high attention to detail with the ability to effectively multi-task in a fast-paced environment
Ability to handle multiple project assignments, meeting strict deadlines.
Position may require some travel (up to 25%)

The target base salary range for this position will range from $114,000 to $143,000 annually. Individual compensation for this job requisition will be based on non-discriminatory factors, including your geographic location, skills, experience, education and other factors as they relate to the position requirements. Experience managing complex, customer-facing work involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, risks, competing priorities, and technical escalations.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to maintain clear documentation, coordinate across teams, and drive issues through resolution.
Experience developing and improving workflows, playbooks, technical guidance, training materials, and knowledge resources that enable consistent execution.
Proficiency with CRM, project-management, and workflow tools such as Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms, as well as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and feedback to identify trends, surface risks, and improve operational performance.
Experience in public safety, SaaS, video technology, physical security technology, connected hardware, or a comparable technical environment is preferred.
Must pass a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) background check and maintain CJIS clearance.
Ability to handle confidential and highly sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment.

Discretionary paid time off

Fitness Programs

jobs.title: Localization Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Summary

Avetta is seeking a highly skilled Localization Technical Program Manager
to set technical direction and serve as an embedded partner across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing. You will make Avetta’s products globally ready by connecting product engineering, localization technology, and release delivery. This hands-on leadership role combines internationalization (i18n) engineering, localization-systems ownership, and technical program leadership to ensure Avetta’s products are designed for global markets and its localization workflows are reliable, scalable, and integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You will lead technical delivery across product i18n and the localization technology ecosystem, from early design through release. This includes ownership of Phrase/TMS configuration, APIs and integrations, Avetta’s central platform for AI-enabled translation, workflow automation, release readiness, and technical enablement for the localization team. You will establish standards, guide implementation, and help resolve complex technical and process issues. The role requires a highly specialized combination of deep i18n knowledge and hands-on localization systems expertise. Targeted i18n and localization quality metrics may be used to identify issues and guide improvements, but analytics and reporting are not the primary focus of the role.

If residing within commutable distance to one of our offices, a hybrid schedule would be required (3 days in office, 2 days work from home). Candidates within commutable distance are preferred, but those outside of an office area may be considered on a remote basis.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Design and implement i18n solutions within the software development lifecycle, including string externalization, resource-file architecture, Unicode and encoding support, and scalable patterns for locale-aware product behavior.
Define and review locale behavior across products, including pluralization, grammatical variants, date, time, number, and currency formats, time zones, sorting, and other regional conventions.
Ensure product readiness for right-to-left (RTL) languages and protect variables, placeholders, markups, and other non-translatable elements throughout content and translation workflows.
Partner with Localization Testing to support pseudo-localization, functional validation, defect triage, and release readiness.
Own and administer Phrase or a comparable Translation Management System (TMS), including project and workflow configuration, translation memories, termbases, quality settings, permissions, automation, and lifecycle governance.
Design, maintain, and troubleshoot TMS/API workflows and integrations with product repositories, content systems, and delivery pipelines. Serve as the technical escalation point for localization systems and process issues.
Serve as the technical product owner for Avetta's central platform for AI-enabled translation, defining its roadmap, architecture, capabilities, and integration strategy across TMS and localization workflows. Translate localization needs into technical requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions in partnership with Product and Engineering.
Identify and support opportunities to streamline and automate localization workflows, including translation, review, and delivery. Lead automation of the localization defect and bug-triage process, applying AI where appropriate across these workflows.
Lead localization technical programs from planning through release, managing scope, dependencies, risks, priorities, and regional requirements while coordinating Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing.
Embed localization requirements and best practices early in product discovery, design, and development. Provide hands-on guidance during implementation and respond quickly to release critical issues.
Help localization team members resolve technical and process issues; create practical documentation and enablement. Pull and interpret targeted i18n, localization quality, or workflow-health metrics when needed to diagnose trends and guide improvements.

Ideal Education, Training, And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in internationalization engineering, localization engineering, localization technology, or a closely related discipline.
Fluency in a second language is preferred. In addition to English, preferred languages may include, but are not limited to, German, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, or other languages that support global collaboration and cross-cultural communication.
Deep knowledge of i18n fundamentals, including string externalization, locale-aware behavior, pluralization, date/number/currency formatting, RTL support, Unicode, and placeholder or markup protection.
Hands-on expertise configuring and administering Phrase or comparable TMS, including translation memories, termbases, workflow automation, quality controls, permissions, and troubleshooting.
Experience building or supporting localization APIs and integrations; familiarity with formats and technologies such as JSON, XML, XLIFF, ICU MessageFormat, REST APIs, webhooks, source control, and CI/CD is strongly preferred.
Experience designing AI-enabled products and workflows, including LLM and Machine Translation integrations, prompt design, API-based orchestration, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop quality controls.
Strong technical program management, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience working in Agile software development and release environments across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, and testing teams.
Ability to provide timely support during releases and maintain substantial working hours overlap with Avetta's core Product and Engineering teams. Experience using i18n or localization quality metrics is helpful; dashboarding or data-visualization expertise is not required.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to prototype solutions, develop workflow automations, document technical designs, or accelerate implementation is strongly preferred. Ability to contribute through APIs or scripting is beneficial; production software development is not required.

The final compensation offered to a candidate will be determined by several factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $149,000 USD per year.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Within Data Center Engineering, the Security Solutions team is the newest generations of Security technologies from concept to production readiness in our data centers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to engage with and lead the Technical Program Management aspect for these advanced cloud infrastructure solutions and the exceptional people that develop them. During a new device deployment, the Sr. Technical Program Manager understands the end customer’s needs to ensure successful product deployment from production to launch, to make Data Center operations more efficient, safe, and secure.

Key job responsibilities

Build strategic plans for new Security Solutions and methods to reach maturity for global deployment.
Plan for global and regional nuances, test and validate, create deployment schedules, and similar production readiness actions
Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of Security Systems for our next generation data center in a highly cross-functional environment, which includes internal customers, hardware, and software development teams.
Provide program management leadership in the application of new technologies and/or retro-fit type work to enable large scale hardware deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience.
Drive teams across multiple organizations to deliver complex cross-functional programs with high impact to the organization.

A day in the life

Our TPMs work closely with key partners to innovate, create, manage, and deliver holistic programs, and ensure products are fully production ready at launch. “Production ready at launch” addresses requirements for a product to be viable for global deployment: approved financials, technical specifications and designs, supplier sourcing and qualification, testing, operations training, and similar requirements. We build and execute the plan that addresses requirements in these areas, resulting in a product or solution that is production ready for global deployment.

About The Team

The Security Solutions team provides engineering expertise and design support for security products in data centers globally. We own and support security products throughout their lifecycle. Our scope also includes emergent global scale remediation strategic efforts that impact Data Center capacity or availability and introducing and driving business improvement initiatives increasing visibility and enabling data driven decision making. Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Hybrid Work

We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our US Amazon offices.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

AI is reshaping how engineering teams operate, and we are investing in solutions that bring chatbots, agents, and assistant intelligence into the core of hardware workflows. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will play a critical role in turning this vision into reality — driving multi-functional programs, scaling systems, and delivering AI capabilities that transform how silicon is designed, verified, and brought to production. This role will also help enable AI productivity across hardware teams by making both internal and third-party AI tools available, understanding user requirements, and translating feedback back to internal platform teams and external partners. Spanning ASIC and research org, this role drives execution in close collaboration with engineers across all teams. We emphasize having influence over technical direction, not just performing tasks or tracking metrics. You should consider yourself an expert in chip design workflows and AI — or demonstrate a strong willingness to learn. Our mission is to enable NVIDIA to design and deliver world-class silicon faster than ever using AI while ensuring performance, efficiency, and resilience.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of AI for Chip Design initiatives, ensuring timely, on-scope, and scalable delivery
Define program plans and timelines for AI capabilities, tracking progress, partnership status, risks, opportunities, and reporting status to leadership
Lead technical discussions between AI engineers, hardware teams, platform groups, and third-party tool providers to ensure alignment on requirements, architecture, integration, and delivery expectations
Operationalize the evaluation of both internal and external AI tools, drive their availability and adoption by collaborating with hardware teams, providing guidance, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement
Act as a product and program interface between silicon design teams, internal AI platform teams, and third-party partners, helping prioritize requirements and translate user needs into actionable roadmaps
Establish and monitor key program metrics to measure execution success, identify bottlenecks, and ensure delivery meets quality, performance, and scalability targets
Serve as the central point of communication for all collaborators, providing clear status updates and insights into dependencies.
Partner with engineering leaders to prioritize initiatives that improve impact for silicon development and hardware workflows

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with proven experience leading complex, multi-functional technical programs in AI, silicon, or infrastructure
10+ years of technical program management spanning AI and ASIC chip design
Strong understanding of RTL design, simulation, and formal verification, as well as software engineering fundamentals, system architecture, and scalable infrastructure
Hands-on experience building, deploying, integrating, or enabling AI agents, LLM-powered systems, or AI productivity tools in real-world engineering workflows
Proven ability to collaborate deeply with engineering teams and influence technical decisions, architecture, prioritization, and trade-offs
Experience driving programs from concept through production, including planning, execution, risk management, team alignment, and delivery at scale
Ability to gather, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from technical users, and communicate them clearly to internal engineering teams and external partners
Excellent communication and leadership, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear program direction and updates

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience in hardware or silicon development environments, understanding RTL, verification, and pre-silicon workflows
Experience evaluating, integrating, or deploying third-party tools into enterprise engineering environments
Familiarity with cloud-scale infrastructure, orchestration systems, and data pipelines for AI applications
Experience with cross-geography coordination and leading large teams or projects spanning multiple sites

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until July 5, 2026.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Program Manager – is responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of enterprise‑level growth programs, including new site builds, site expansions, and facilities readiness required to meet committed product launch timelines.

This role owns programs from requirements definition through site launch and operational handoff, working backwards from target launch dates to ensure facilities, infrastructure, resources, and cross‑functional capabilities are fully aligned. The Program Manager acts as the single point of accountability and applies Project Management Institute (PMI) standards to ensure disciplined planning, execution, and delivery across multiple complex programs.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Definition & Customer Alignment

Ensure all project requirements, objectives, and customer needs (internal and/or external) are clearly gathered, understood, and translated into executable plans
Collaborate with customers and business units from requirements gathering through product acceptance and site launch
Align program teams to customer and business needs by establishing clear milestones, goals, and objectives informed by all functional stakeholders
Devise creative and practical solutions to critical customer, user, and business requirements

Program Planning, Controls & Execution (PMI
‑Based)

Develop and manage integrated program plans using PMI standards, covering scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and change management
Coordinate with functional project managers and project coordinators to review and integrate detailed project schedules
Manage execution of tasks to completion in accordance with approved schedules and baselines
Maintain accountability for overall project success, balancing cost, schedule, scope, and quality against enterprise requirements

Cross
‑Functional & Enterprise Leadership

Build, lead, and motivate cross‑functional teams to deliver multiple and/or enterprise‑level programs, including:
Facilities & Engineering
Manufacturing & Operations
IT / Systems
Supply Chain & Procurement
Finance
Legal
Human Resources
Business Units / Commercial
Serve as the primary interface with customers, vendors, stakeholders, and project sponsors
Communicate program objectives in the context of overall strategic business goals
Provide guidance, coaching, and motivation to teams through complex and high‑pressure delivery environments

Financial, Resource & KPI Management

Perform financial management and cost analysis, including:
Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs)
Resource allocation
Travel, training, and other program‑related costs

Forecast project budgets and labor requirements to support current and future site needs
Manage resource capacity and time tracking across enterprise‑level programs
Define, monitor, and manage project‑specific KPIs, ensuring work is delivered within scope, time, cost, and quality constraints

Risk, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Develop integrated risk analyses with actionable mitigation plans
Identify potential problem areas early and implement alternative solutions as needed
Obtain, analyze, and summarize program status versus performance baselines
Report program status, issues, outcomes, and implemented solutions to leadership
Provide leaders with clear insights into risks, opportunities, and improvement areas
Identify and implement cost‑reduction opportunities through process optimization and system improvements
Drive continuous improvement through metrics management, trend analysis, and best‑practice sharing across sites and teams

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

Deliver clear, concise, and effective communication through a variety of channels
Design consistent, audience‑appropriate messaging for diverse stakeholder groups
Work closely with communications, stakeholders, and leadership to evaluate and measure program effectiveness and business impact
Design and facilitate training related to enterprise initiatives and program implementation
Demonstrate strong customer focus by anticipating needs, resolving issues quickly, and coaching others through complex decision‑making situations

Compliance & Additional Responsibilities

Comply with all company security policies, procedures, and governance requirements
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience leading complex, cross‑functional, enterprise‑level programs
Proven experience delivering facilities‑driven or capital‑intensive initiatives (site builds, expansions, infrastructure programs)
Strong ability to translate requirements into executable plans and drive delivery across matrixed teams
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification – preferred
Demonstrated expertise applying PMI standards and methodologies across the full project lifecycle
Experience supporting product launches or large‑scale growth initiatives
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills

Why This Role Matters

This role ensures growth programs are delivered with clarity, discipline, and predictability, enabling sites to be stood up and products launched in alignment with business and customer commitments—while maintaining rigorous cost, schedule, and quality control.

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Program/Project Manager III, Operations Initiatives reports directly to the Chief Operations Officer and Executive Vice President and is responsible for the management of complex projects, programs, and initiatives in support of CapMetro’s Operations capital improvement plan, operational expenditure plan, and strategic objectives. This role requires an experienced and proactive individual with a proven record of successfully leading cross-functional project teams and the ability to drive strategic organizational outcomes through effective project management.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Note: The duties and primary responsibilities below are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this job and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. 

Project Management: For assigned projects and programs, develop, manage, and maintain the critical project management deliverables, including scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risk analysis, quality assurance, lessons learned, and status reports. Coordinate cross-functional activities to achieve project outcomes.
Program Management: For assigned programs, develop, manage, and maintain the critical program management deliverables and provide technical and innovative insight to help ensure each project is completed with the proper balance of quality, cost, and schedule. Align, integrate, and control program components and resources to ensure program goals are met, benefits are delivered optimally, and risks are effectively managed.
Communication and Reporting: Track progress and provide status updates to appropriate leadership. Collaborate with the project owner to ensure project expectations are proactively communicated. Responsible for reporting on project status, milestones, and risk as well as scope, schedule, and budget.
Procurement: Develop and assist in the procurement process, which may include assisting in the creation of statements of work, independent cost estimates, fair and reasonable determinations, Board agenda items, executive memos, and other documents.
Resource Management: Collaborate with CapMetro business and technical team leadership to ensure that solutions stay within scope, cost and schedule, and that risks are properly documented, managed, and mitigated.
Process Expertise: Adhere to CapMetro project and program standards and provide technical leadership to project management staff and teams.
Budget and Cost Forecasting: Adhere to budget and cost forecasting requirements for projects. Collaborate with other departments in the continuous improvement of project budgeting and forecasting.
Field Work: Conduct field work and field visits as required for project execution and effectively understand the specific operation of all elements involved.
Records Management: Manage project planning specific documentation and then properly processed internally with various departments that require updates.
Support Capital Metropolitan Transportation Authority’s Safety Management Systems (SMS) process by ensuring staff follows safety and security policies, considers safety in every action, and ensures safety and security concerns are reported.
Perform other duties as required and/or assigned.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING

Bachelor’s degree in project management, information technology, public administration, or related subject area. Additional related experience may substitute for a degree on a year-for-year basis up to four years.
Master’s degree may substitute for two years of work experience preferred.
Six (6) years of experience leading cross-functional projects and/or programs from initiation through completion, including responsibility for planning, budgeting, procurement, resource management, and reporting, demonstrated success leading the implementation of complex projects, programs, and portfolios.
Proficient experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, and SharePoint.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Institute (PMI) preferred.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Experience using Planview to develop a project schedule, assign resources to tasks, track progress, and analyze workloads is preferred.
Familiarity with transit industry, public sector, or technology and construction projects preferred.
Knowledge of project management practices for managing cost, schedule, and performance.
Ability to demonstrate a proactive, collaborative approach with team members, consultants, vendors, and contractors.
Ability to understand, develop, and manage project technical details and find solutions.
Effective communication and ability to identify and communicate risks.
Self-motivated and focused on opportunities to continuously improve skills and processes. Ability to work in a team environment in a matrix organization, partnering well with other employees, management, stakeholders, users, business personnel, vendors, service providers, and contractors.
Motivated to undertake project management duties and tasks as assigned.
Ability to be a positive and constructive contributor in a team-based environment. Excellent attention to detail.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Work is performed in an office and outdoor environments, with exposure to inclement and adverse weather conditions. This position works with multiple project timelines and is responsible for directing employees performing work of a complex nature.

Incumbent must have the ability to stand, walk and travel 90% throughout the workday. This position will need to have the ability to work varying shifts, days, nights, weekends, holidays, and rotating shifts, to meet the department’s needs. Must be able to safely operate a motor vehicle. Must be able to use a telephone or headset equipment. Incumbents must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs., perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day, and function in an environment with constant interruptions. This position may require work beyond a normal forty-hour weekly schedule. Regular and predictable attendance at assigned work location is an essential function.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disability to perform the essential functions as previously described.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

Mobility Status

As a Hybrid
position, onsite presence is guided by team collaboration needs, customer and front-line team member interactions, and role responsibilities. People leaders will set expectations for onsite presence; however, incumbents are generally encouraged to work 8 to 12 days in office per month. Mobility status is subject to change at any time based on business needs or organizational decisions.

COMMITMENT TO EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CapMetro is an equal employment opportunity employer and committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, pregnancy, age, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Project Manager (Data Centers)
to join us in Houston, TX.
The following locations will also be considered: San Diego, CA, New York, NY, Houston, TX, Portland, OR and Seattle, WA
. This position can be offered remotely.

As demand for AI, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure accelerates, our clients are developing some of the world's largest, most complex, and most power-intensive facilities. In this role, you will help deliver the electrical infrastructure that enables next-generation data center campuses—projects requiring hundreds of megawatts of power and unprecedented levels of planning, engineering, and coordination. You will work across the full project lifecycle, playing a key role in delivering critical infrastructure for some of the industry's most prominent clients.

What makes this opportunity unique is the breadth of collaboration across WSP's global organization. You will work alongside top experts in their field to solve highly complex infrastructure challenges. This multidisciplinary environment provides exposure to the full range of technical and strategic considerations required to successfully develop large-scale data center campuses. You will contribute to the planning and design of substations, transmission interconnections, and site electrical infrastructure while supporting fast-paced projects that demand innovation, technical excellence, and strong collaboration.

If you're energized by large-scale infrastructure projects, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while accelerating your career on some of the most significant power delivery projects being developed today.

Provides technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of critical high-voltage infrastructure for data center projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. Tasks include responsibility for overall performance of distribution system and grid modernization projects of moderate size/complexity and/or local/regional scope. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.

Your Impact

Lead and oversee cross-functional teams delivering power distribution and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and distribution projects.
Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power & energy market.
Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for power delivery projects.
Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in all aspects of distribution design.
Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects.
Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future projects.
Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of experience managing projects in power distribution, transmission & distribution (T&D), or utility engineering environments.
Proven experience delivering feeder, distribution line, or grid modernization projects.
Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in complex utility environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
PMI Certification (PMP or CAPM).

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, MADS
jobs.description:
Description

Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About The Team

The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations.

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
