jobs.title: Localization Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Summary

Avetta is seeking a highly skilled Localization Technical Program Manager
to set technical direction and serve as an embedded partner across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing. You will make Avetta’s products globally ready by connecting product engineering, localization technology, and release delivery. This hands-on leadership role combines internationalization (i18n) engineering, localization-systems ownership, and technical program leadership to ensure Avetta’s products are designed for global markets and its localization workflows are reliable, scalable, and integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You will lead technical delivery across product i18n and the localization technology ecosystem, from early design through release. This includes ownership of Phrase/TMS configuration, APIs and integrations, Avetta’s central platform for AI-enabled translation, workflow automation, release readiness, and technical enablement for the localization team. You will establish standards, guide implementation, and help resolve complex technical and process issues. The role requires a highly specialized combination of deep i18n knowledge and hands-on localization systems expertise. Targeted i18n and localization quality metrics may be used to identify issues and guide improvements, but analytics and reporting are not the primary focus of the role.

If residing within commutable distance to one of our offices, a hybrid schedule would be required (3 days in office, 2 days work from home). Candidates within commutable distance are preferred, but those outside of an office area may be considered on a remote basis.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Design and implement i18n solutions within the software development lifecycle, including string externalization, resource-file architecture, Unicode and encoding support, and scalable patterns for locale-aware product behavior.
Define and review locale behavior across products, including pluralization, grammatical variants, date, time, number, and currency formats, time zones, sorting, and other regional conventions.
Ensure product readiness for right-to-left (RTL) languages and protect variables, placeholders, markups, and other non-translatable elements throughout content and translation workflows.
Partner with Localization Testing to support pseudo-localization, functional validation, defect triage, and release readiness.
Own and administer Phrase or a comparable Translation Management System (TMS), including project and workflow configuration, translation memories, termbases, quality settings, permissions, automation, and lifecycle governance.
Design, maintain, and troubleshoot TMS/API workflows and integrations with product repositories, content systems, and delivery pipelines. Serve as the technical escalation point for localization systems and process issues.
Serve as the technical product owner for Avetta's central platform for AI-enabled translation, defining its roadmap, architecture, capabilities, and integration strategy across TMS and localization workflows. Translate localization needs into technical requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions in partnership with Product and Engineering.
Identify and support opportunities to streamline and automate localization workflows, including translation, review, and delivery. Lead automation of the localization defect and bug-triage process, applying AI where appropriate across these workflows.
Lead localization technical programs from planning through release, managing scope, dependencies, risks, priorities, and regional requirements while coordinating Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing.
Embed localization requirements and best practices early in product discovery, design, and development. Provide hands-on guidance during implementation and respond quickly to release critical issues.
Help localization team members resolve technical and process issues; create practical documentation and enablement. Pull and interpret targeted i18n, localization quality, or workflow-health metrics when needed to diagnose trends and guide improvements.

Ideal Education, Training, And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in internationalization engineering, localization engineering, localization technology, or a closely related discipline.
Fluency in a second language is preferred. In addition to English, preferred languages may include, but are not limited to, German, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, or other languages that support global collaboration and cross-cultural communication.
Deep knowledge of i18n fundamentals, including string externalization, locale-aware behavior, pluralization, date/number/currency formatting, RTL support, Unicode, and placeholder or markup protection.
Hands-on expertise configuring and administering Phrase or comparable TMS, including translation memories, termbases, workflow automation, quality controls, permissions, and troubleshooting.
Experience building or supporting localization APIs and integrations; familiarity with formats and technologies such as JSON, XML, XLIFF, ICU MessageFormat, REST APIs, webhooks, source control, and CI/CD is strongly preferred.
Experience designing AI-enabled products and workflows, including LLM and Machine Translation integrations, prompt design, API-based orchestration, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop quality controls.
Strong technical program management, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience working in Agile software development and release environments across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, and testing teams.
Ability to provide timely support during releases and maintain substantial working hours overlap with Avetta's core Product and Engineering teams. Experience using i18n or localization quality metrics is helpful; dashboarding or data-visualization expertise is not required.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to prototype solutions, develop workflow automations, document technical designs, or accelerate implementation is strongly preferred. Ability to contribute through APIs or scripting is beneficial; production software development is not required.

Programs managed are broad in scope, often unprecedented in approach, and carry significant global impact to the organization’s operations and decision-making capabilities.

A defining dimension of this role is the ability to serve as a trusted liaison between technical delivery teams and business partners — translating analytical needs into executable technical strategy, and ensuring the BI team consistently delivers measurable, mission-aligned value.

Note: This is a 5-year, fixed-term position.

This individual works with divine guidance to provide or support technology that furthers the mission of the Church and reflects the eternal impact of the gospel.

We value early, mid, and late-career candidates and encourage all applicants with the posted skills and abilities to apply.

BI & Analytics Program Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery of Business Intelligence and Analytics programs, from requirements gathering through deployment and adoption.
Define scope, tasks, priorities, and delivery milestones across the BI program portfolio, ensuring alignment with business strategy and organizational KPIs.
Provide continuous assessment of program risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies; proactively surface blockers to senior leadership.
Champion development processes, data governance standards, and engineering best practices across BI and analytics workstreams.
Lead program reviews to assess schedule adherence, solution architecture quality, and process compliance.

Technical Direction & Oversight

Maintain a working understanding of the full BI/Analytics technical stack to credibly guide engineering teams and evaluate architectural trade-offs, including:
Data modeling (dimensional, normalized, and hybrid approaches)
ETL and ELT pipeline design, orchestration, and optimization

dbt (data build tool) for transformation layer management, testing, and documentation
DAG-based workflow orchestration (e.g., Apache Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
Scheduled jobs, dependency management, and pipeline monitoring strategies
BI semantic and reporting layers, dashboarding, and self-service analytics tooling
Partner with data architects and senior engineers to validate solution design, ensure scalability, and uphold data quality standards throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Team Leadership & Development

Drive the BI team to consistently deliver on commitments by establishing clear ownership, fostering accountability, and removing organizational impediments.
Work with Solution Manager and functional managers to identify and onboard appropriate data engineers, analytics engineers, and other team members for program workstreams.
Participate in iteration and release planning alongside development team leadership, balancing technical debt, new capability delivery, and business-priority sequencing.
Cultivate a team culture centered on data quality, continuous improvement, and delivering analytics solutions that are trustworthy, well-documented, and easily maintained.

Business Partner Relationship Management

Act as the primary point of accountability for business Product stakeholders, translating BI/Data Analytics goals and analytical needs into well-scoped program requirements.

CarMax, the way your career should be!

Senior Program Manager

Role Anchor:
Owns complex, ambiguous, cross-functional business and technology initiatives by framing problems, shaping practical solution paths, aligning business and Technology partners, and driving work through implementation and adoption.

About This Job

The Senior Program Manager at CarMax Auto Finance is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives that require strong problem-solving, operational understanding, and technology fluency. This role partners with business leaders, Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Risk, Learning, Communications, and other stakeholders to understand business problems, evaluate solution options, and drive work from discovery through implementation.

This role goes beyond coordinating work or managing project plans. The Senior Program Manager takes ownership of ambiguous problems, asks effective questions, examines how processes and systems work together, and helps teams identify practical paths forward. The role evaluates whether a need may be addressed through process redesign, automation, reporting or data improvements, AI-enabled capabilities, technology enhancements, or a combination of solutions.

The Senior Program Manager develops a strong understanding of CAF processes, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, and operational workflows. While not responsible for detailed requirements or technical design, this role brings enough business and technical fluency to shape solution options, evaluate tradeoffs, recognize cross-functional impacts, and connect business needs with Technology capabilities.

What You Will Do – Essential Responsibilities

Own complex, ambiguous cross-functional initiatives by clarifying the business problem, intended outcomes, customer and associate impacts, operational context, and key constraints. Lead early problem-framing and solution-shaping by gathering facts, asking thoughtful questions, challenging assumptions, and engaging the right business, Product, Technology, and analytical partners. Develop a working understanding of current processes, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, and handoffs to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement. Evaluate practical solution options across process redesign, workflow automation, reporting and data improvements, configurable technology, integrations, AI-enabled capabilities, and broader operational change. Facilitate decision-making across stakeholders by clarifying tradeoffs, operational impacts, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and recommendations needed to move work forward. Connect work across multiple functions, products, systems, and Technology teams to ensure decisions, sequencing, dependencies, and implementation plans support a cohesive end-to-end solution. Lead implementation and operational readiness by coordinating communications, training, controls, documentation, adoption, support, transition needs, and early post-launch issue resolution. Create clear executive-level materials and governance updates including decision summaries, solution recommendations, roadmaps, risks, status updates, and measurable success outcomes.

Purpose of the Role

The Senior Program Manager helps CAF solve complex business problems that require coordination and solution shaping across business and Technology teams. This role ensures the problem is sufficiently understood, the appropriate partners are engaged, practical solution options are evaluated, and work progresses from ambiguity to implementation and adoption.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, outcome-oriented, and comfortable operating with limited direction. They understand how processes, people, systems, data, integrations, and controls work together and can connect business needs with technology-enabled opportunities. They use structured thinking, operational knowledge, and technical fluency to identify options, surface tradeoffs, and guide teams toward practical, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

The Senior Program Manager Typically Leads Work Involving

Multiple business functions, products, or Technology platforms
High ambiguity or material organizational impact
Significant regulatory, financial, customer, operational, or reputational risk
Complex sequencing and resource conflicts
Multiple senior-level decision makers
CAF-wide or enterprise impact
Executive governance and visibility
Limited precedent or an undefined delivery path
A need to establish the program structure and governance model

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, program management, technology, operations, finance, analytics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional programs, business initiatives, technology-enabled change, process improvement, or transformation efforts.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems, establish clarity, evaluate alternatives, synthesize complex information, and move work forward with limited direction.
Experience facilitating discovery, solution-shaping, and decision-making discussions across business, Product, Technology, Operations, and control partners.
Strong understanding of business processes, operational workflows, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, technology constraints, and the operational effects of technology changes.
Ability to evaluate solution options involving process redesign, automation, reporting, data, integrations, configurable platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, or technology enhancements while identifying risks, dependencies, cross-functional impacts, and implementation considerations.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, align stakeholders across functions and organizational levels, manage competing priorities, and facilitate decisions involving business value, feasibility, risk, resources, and timing.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing executive summaries, decision materials, solution recommendations, roadmaps, stakeholder communications, and implementation/adoption materials.
Preferred experience with Agile, Waterfall, hybrid delivery approaches, or technology-delivery practices; consumer finance, auto finance, financial services, operations, technology, analytics, risk, or process-improvement environments.

jobs.description:
Third‑Party IT Risk Manager
is responsible for leading and modernizing Wolters Kluwer’s global third‑party cyber risk management capability across a highly distributed, market‑driven technology and supplier landscape. This role ensures third-party engagements align with the organization’s risk appetite, security standards, and regulatory expectations and lead the execution of a scalable, intelligence‑led TPRM program that delivers meaningful and defensible assurance over third‑party cyber risk—moving beyond traditional, questionnaire‑centric models.

The role partners closely with Global Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal, and Privacy teams to reduce fragmentation across markets by translating diverse, market‑specific approaches into standardized enterprise agreements, security configurations, and control expectations. A core focus of this position is innovation: designing and implementing differentiated third‑party assurance approaches that leverage automation, technical validation, and continuous monitoring to provide real‑time insight into supplier risk rather than relying solely on static assessments.

Responsibilities:

Program Leadership & Modernization

Lead and evolve Wolters Kluwer’s global Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program and operating model, ensuring it is scalable, risk based, and aligned with enterprise cyber risk governance.
Modernize TPITRM by shifting from a primarily questionnaire driven approach to a data driven program that incorporates technical validation, continuous monitoring, AI, and risk quantification.
Lead, whether functionally or formally – junior team members as a manager level leader across the TPRM function to drive successful outcomes across the entire TPRM unit.

Continuous Monitoring, Automation & Innovation

Implement continuous monitoring capabilities to deliver near real time visibility into third party cyber posture, control performance, and emerging risk indicators.
Design and deploy innovative approaches—including automation and AI assisted techniques—for evidence collection, risk scoring, and exception management.
Continuously assess emerging tools, data sources, and assurance models to improve risk coverage, reduce assessment friction, and enhance signal quality beyond traditional questionnaires.

Contract Review:

Strong skills in the development, review, and analysis of third party contracts to ensure Company requirements, principles, and assets are sufficiently protected in accordance with internal expectations.
Strong business acumen and ability to identify technical and functional requirements that do not align or meet Company needs, suggest enhancements, and have them accepted and implemented by the supplier.

Governance, Reporting & Escalation

Maintain a centralized, enterprise wide inventory of third party relationships, risk tiers, and risk treatment decisions.
Provide clear, concise reporting on third party cyber risk posture, trends, and concentration risk to senior leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

Build, lead, and develop a high performing team of third party risk professionals and technical reviewers.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and constructive challenge consistent with Wolters Kluwer values and operating principles.

Job Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, information security, management information systems or similar.
12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security, including significant ownership of third party or supplier cyber risk management in large, complex enterprises.
5+ years of leadership (direct managerial experience or functional delivery leading teams).
Proven experience designing and leading a global TPRM program across the full third party risk lifecycle.
Demonstrated success modernizing TPRM by implementing risk based approaches that integrate technical validation, automation, and continuous monitoring.
Demonstrated success owning decisions and outcomes at a senior level independently without formal authority.
Strong technical fluency across cloud platforms, APIs, identity, data flows, and integration architectures, with the ability to partner credibly with security architects and technical SMEs.
Experience overseeing advanced technical assessments for high risk or critical third parties, such as architecture reviews, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and threat modeling.
Ability to operate effectively in highly distributed, market driven environments.
Demonstrated leadership experience, including building high performing teams and influencing senior stakeholders across Technology, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and Enterprise Risk Management.
Strong executive communication skills, with experience reporting third party cyber risk posture and trends to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualification

Familiarity with systemic, concentration, and fourth‑party risk.
Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CTPRP, CRISC, CISA)

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth.

We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams.

The Opportunity

Rocket Travel by Agoda is seeking a Compliance Program Manager
– Partner Controls and Compliance to join our growing Partner Controls and Compliance team. In this role, you will play an essential part in safeguarding the interests and enhancing the success of our partners by navigating, monitoring, and gatekeeping complex and evolving partner requirements. You will tackle complex compliance challenges with thorough research surfacing gaps, identifying trade-offs, and enabling informed decision-making. This role will shape the future of our compliance program through optimization to identify inefficiencies, recommend improvements, and implement solutions that scale.This role is crucial in maintaining the integrity and success of our partnerships.

What You'll Do

Execute the day-to-day management and continuous optimization of the Compliance Management System (CMS). The four main elements of the program include:
Element 1: Coordinate the end-to-end process for external assessments, ensuring timely remediation and ongoing improvement of the control environment. Maintain organized archives of support materials.
Element 2: Monitor vendor information and activities; flag emerging risks or control gaps early; validate that monitoring aligns with partner requirements and escalate misalignments.
Element 3: Own the design, delivery, and effectiveness of annual compliance training programs ensuring partner requirements are met.
Element 4: Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of compliance governance documentation and reporting.

Support as a risk and compliance subject matter expert to our highly regulated external partners. Own solutions to complex partner requirements with the ability to communicate to partners concisely.
Advise internal cross-functional teams on compliance requirements, risk mitigation, and process improvements; delivering well-researched recommendations.
Promote a culture of integrity and accountability through clear communication and collaboration across all organizational levels.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, or process improvement.
Solid understanding of internal controls, regulatory frameworks, and Compliance Management Systems (CMS).
Self-motivated and proactive problem solver, with the ability to navigate ambiguity to deliver strong results.
Experience improving Governance, Risk, & Compliance (GRC) tools and compliance processes with a demonstrated track record of identifying gaps and delivering process enhancements.
Identifies and implements opportunities to use AI and automation to enhance compliance efficiency while ensuring that all AI-driven recommendations are validated.
Excels at managing multiple priorities across partnerships autonomously and maintains accountability for cross-functional execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to distill complex information into clear, actionable insights for various audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with banking partners or airline partners.
Project management in the travel industry.

Job Description

Manage physical security workforce service providers across the region, driving service quality and efficiency through clear KPIs and SLAs.

Own the risk profile at regional locations and implement tailored mitigation measures in alignment with the global risk framework.

Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

The Senior IT Project Manager is a seasoned project delivery leader responsible for successfully managing complex, enterprise-wide technology initiatives from inception through completion. This role provides end-to-end ownership of project execution, including strategic planning, stakeholder engagement, risk and issue management, governance oversight, budget and schedule control, and transparent communication of project progress, decisions, and outcomes. Partnering closely with Portfolio Managers, executive sponsors, Domain Leads, Enterprise Architects, technical teams, and business stakeholders, the Senior IT Project Manager translates business objectives into actionable project roadmaps and drives delivery excellence. By balancing technical, operational, and business priorities, this individual ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards while achieving measurable business value and organizational objectives.

What The Role Offers

Manage complex IT projects from initiation through deployment and closure, ensuring delivery within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
Translate sponsor objectives, project requirements, and business needs into clear project charters, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and execution approaches.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and delivery partners to drive execution, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment with project objectives and expected business outcomes.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, including workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource assumptions, financial tracking, and delivery constraints.
Apply PMO methodology and Project Navigator practices to ensure required documentation, approvals, decision logs, change controls, and governance artifacts are complete and current.
Support benefits definition and tracking by partnering with requestors and sponsors to clarify expected outcomes, success measures, and business value for assigned projects.
Prepare clear, decision-oriented reporting for sponsors, Portfolio Managers, project governance forums, and stakeholders, highlighting delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and required actions.
Proactively identify risks and issues, develop mitigation plans, escalate appropriately, and drive timely resolution across business and technical teams.
Serve as the primary project delivery contact for sponsors, Domain Leads, technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and PMO leadership.
Communicate complex project information in a concise, audience-appropriate manner, ensuring stakeholders understand progress, risks, decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
Lead without direct authority by creating accountability, building trust, and enabling collaboration across cross-functional project teams.
Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned, identifying process gaps, and supporting PMO standards, templates, reporting practices, and tool adoption.

What You Need To Succeed

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience considered.
6+ years of progressive project management experience, preferably managing complex, cross-functional IT projects in a matrixed enterprise environment.
Proven ability to deliver complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
Strong knowledge of project lifecycle management, governance, change control, risk and issue management, financial tracking, project reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Well-versed in Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid delivery approaches.
PMP certification preferred; PMI-ACP, ITIL, PRINCE2, or other relevant certifications considered an asset.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, project planning tools, PPM/reporting platforms, and collaboration technologies.
Interest in AI learning and practical application of AI-enabled tools to improve planning, reporting, risk visibility, project controls, and delivery outcomes.

ONE LAST THING

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will lead complex, enterprise-wide technology initiatives from strategy through successful delivery, partnering with executive sponsors, technical teams, and business leaders to drive impactful outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for a collaborative and results-driven project management professional to oversee planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and execution across high-visibility projects. You'll play a key role in translating business objectives into actionable roadmaps, leading cross-functional teams, championing continuous improvement, and leveraging modern delivery practices, including Agile, Waterfall, and emerging AI-enabled tools, to deliver measurable business value and lasting organizational impact.

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

InComm Payments works with the most recognized and valued brands in the world, and we are partnered with most of the world’s leading merchants. InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity, and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

The International Implementations team supports Sales, Marketing, IT and Operational efforts in a diverse and challenging global business environment.

As an International Implementations Manager (IM), you will be responsible for managing the delivery of multiple small to medium-size projects which require the ability to lead and influence project stakeholders. On larger and more complex strategic projects, the IM may participate as a consultant or subject matter expert in support of traditional IT Project Management resources. The IM may also be responsible for operational management of 3rd Party Processors and InComm Retailers as it relates to Product Implementations.

When supporting Product Implementations and/or Partner Integrations, it is the IM’s responsibility to conduct a wide variety of Project Management activities across multiple internal and external groups to deliver. Typical projects will include high-level, complex requests with high priority and strategic need. IMs are also expected to lead, mentor, and train less seasoned staff to aid in continual improvement and education efforts. IMs are expected to oversee activities to facilitate project workflow in a timely manner and to break down barriers when necessary to assure the needs of InComm Retailers and Partners are met. Project efforts are consistent in approach and are comprised of many repeatable and process driven tasks.

The role will also deliver documentation and process improvements which increase efficiency in the way InComm executes and drives Partner satisfaction. This role will provide a consolidated, single point of service and communication regarding product implementations internally and externally.

Amazon is seeking an experienced business-oriented Robotics Deployment Project Manager to deliver large-scale and highly complex logistic process automation and storage initiatives for the continued expansion of our Europe (EU) fulfilment network.

The Deployment Project Manager will oversee all aspects of an Amazon Warehouse (Fulfilment Centre, Inbound Cross-Dock, Sortation Centre or Distribution Centre) while focusing on its automation technologies and storage solutions. As a Deployment Engineer you will be responsible for evaluating and delivering state-of-the-art material handling systems and robotic innovations while coordinating internal teams and external contractors in order to effectively launch new automated buildings and conduct expansions in existing sites.

Amazon’s culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dusseldorf, Munich or Vercelli with ~50% of time traveling mainly around the country and with potential requirements in the EU.

Key job responsibilities

Lead evaluation and delivery of large-scale automation technologies, ensuring they are complete, standardized, and ready for global scale.
Support evaluation and delivery of large-scale automation technologies including conveyance, sortation and robotics systems, often occurring across multiple sites at a time
Coordinate cross-functional teams including internal stakeholders and external contractors to ensure successful project delivery
Evaluate and implement state-of-the-art material handling systems and robotic innovations
Ensure deployment deliverables are delivered on time, within the timeline, and to Amazon's quality standards
Provide guidance and troubleshooting for complex automation deployments
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize deployment processes
Collaborate with product, safety, deployment, quality and vendor teams throughout the project lifecycle
Travel 50% of time mainly around the Country and with potential requirements in the EU.

You will be interacting daily with a wide variety of functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization and in multiple time zones. You will conduct multiple weekly meetings with internal teams, stakeholders and vendors to execute deliverables. You’ll be liaising with subject matter experts from across the organization, diving deep in the technologies we deploy; you’ll build on these relationships to refine and improve our processes. No two days will be the same in our fast-moving environment yet you’ll discover endless opportunities to grow along the way as part of a tight-knit and supportive team.

Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfilment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. The role serves as a bridge between clients, internal stakeholders, and technical teams to support solution delivery, data-driven decision-making, and continuous process improvement. jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Commercial Real Estate + Technology

Floorspace is a modern commercial real estate brokerage and technology company, building tools that make brokers faster, smarter, and more efficient. We pair a high-performing brokerage team with our proprietary platform, FLO, to redefine how deals get done.

We’re growing quickly—and we’re looking for a Senior Research Analyst
who can level up our data, insights, and market intelligence.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Research Analyst at Floorspace, you’ll be a core part of our research engine—responsible for leading our market data program, building high-quality insight products, and supporting brokers with the information they need to win business and advise clients.
This role goes beyond standard research: you’ll help shape how Floorspace collects, structures, and leverages data across Vancouver’s commercial real estate market. You’ll oversee data integrity across FLO, guide junior analysts, and collaborate closely with both our brokerage and product teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Market Intelligence & Reporting

Lead quarterly and monthly market research for office, industrial, and retail sectors.
Produce data-driven reports, dashboards, and insights for clients, pitches, and internal visibility.
Monitor leasing activity, construction, subleases, and key market trends across Metro Vancouver.

Data Quality & System Ownership

Oversee and maintain the accuracy of core datasets within FLO (buildings, availabilities, leases, comps).
Establish and refine data standards for research across asset classes.
Improve research workflows and help drive automation and efficiency.

Business Development Support

Prepare insight packages for pitch decks and client proposals.
Identify opportunities in the market for tenant rep outreach, landlord listings, and strategic positioning.
Work closely with senior brokers to frame market narratives and support deal execution with data.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor and support junior analysts and interns.
Work cross-functionally with marketing to elevate our market storytelling.
Partner with our product and engineering teams to shape future FLO features that rely on research data.

Special Projects

Lead deep-dive studies (sublease trends, sector-specific analyses, demand patterns, etc.).
Contribute to new research formats such as our “Floorspace Five,” neighbourhood guides, and property analyses.

Who We’re Looking For

You’re not just comfortable with data-you know how to use it to tell a compelling story. You bring strong analytical grounding, an understanding of commercial real estate, and the ability to translate information into actionable insights.
You have:

3–5+ years of experience in commercial real estate research, valuation, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of CRE fundamentals—leasing, market dynamics, submarkets, and asset types.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience managing datasets and ensuring data integrity.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, especially in synthesizing complex information.
Interest in working closely with both brokerage and product/tech teams.
A proactive, organized, and detail-oriented working style.

Why Join Floorspace?

A tech-enabled brokerage model:

You’ll work within a company where research actually matters - our proprietary tech (FLO) relies heavily on your work and insight.
A collaborative, entrepreneurial team:

Work directly with brokers, marketing, product managers, analysts, and leadership. Ideas are encouraged, and execution is fast.
High-impact role:

Your work will shape our market presence, influence client strategy, and power our internal platform.

Working Conditions

Our head office is located in downtown Vancouver. The team is primarily office-based, with some flexibility for hybrid work.

Compensation

Salary range: $70,000–$90,000
, depending on experience.
Includes a performance-based bonus program.

Make an Impact

If you’re energized by data, passionate about real estate, and eager to play a meaningful role in the growth of a modern brokerage, we’d love to hear from you.

Floorspace values diversity and is committed to Employment Equity.
Direct applicants only-no agencies. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Learn more about us at www.floorspace.ca

jobs.title: Crisis & Incident Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG, a globally respected financial institution, is seeking a Crisis and Incident Data Analyst to join their Operational Resilience Team in London. This role offers you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in strengthening MUFG’s crisis and incident management capabilities across EMEA, ensuring the organisation remains resilient and responsive to disruption. You will be at the heart of data-driven decision-making, providing actionable insights that protect clients, colleagues, and the firm while supporting compliance with FCA, PRA, DORA, and wider operational resilience requirements. MUFG is renowned for its commitment to employee development, inclusive culture, and supportive leadership. The company values collaboration and offers flexible working opportunities, generous pension contributions, and access to training programmes that foster both personal and professional growth. If you are passionate about operational resilience and thrive in environments where your analytical skills can make a real impact, this is an exceptional opportunity to join a team dedicated to safeguarding the future of one of the world’s leading financial services organisations.

What You'll Do

Develop, embed and manage the data landscape across EMEA to support Crisis Management & Incident Management frameworks, tools and methodologies in line with regulatory requirements.
Coordinate depth data analytics across people, process, technology, facilities, information and third-party dependencies within the Operational Resilience pillar to enhance organisational effectiveness.
Deliver a centralised operational incident data model across EMEA that supports governance, audit and regulatory requirements.
Maintain crisis and incident data governance processes including supporting documentation, repositories, reporting inventories and evidence stores.
Develop automated reporting, analytics and dashboard capabilities that improve data quality, efficiency and organisational awareness throughout the business.
Produce management information (MI), KPI/KRI reporting and resilience metrics for forums such as the Operational Resilience Practitioners Forum and Oversight Committee.
Ensure incident records, classifications, impact assessments and reporting information remain accurate, complete, consistent and auditable for regulatory compliance.
Assist with thematic reviews, maturity assessments and capability evaluations by identifying findings, control weaknesses, improvement opportunities and emerging resilience risks.
Coordinate and support Bronze Incident Management Teams as well as Silver/Gold Crisis Management Teams during incidents or crises.
Support integration of data from ServiceNow, Critical Event Management platforms and other resilience tooling while acting as a business SME for reporting capabilities.

What You Bring

Demonstrated experience in Data Analytics preferably within Operational Resilience or Incident Management functions within financial services or similar regulated industries.
Comprehensive understanding of ISO 22361:2022 guidelines for security and resilience—crisis management—and familiarity with regulatory changes caused by PS26/2, PRA PS7/26, FG26/3 or FG23/4.
Knowledge of FCA/PRA Operational Resilience requirements as well as DORA regulations relevant to EMEA operations.
Experience supporting incident or crisis management teams during major events including production of dashboards or executive reports for senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills with proven ability to interpret complex datasets accurately while identifying meaningful trends that inform decision-making processes.
Understanding of operational incident management principles including risk assessment methodologies used in crisis situations.
Experience supporting regulatory reporting activities such as governance or risk reporting within large organisations.
Proficiency working with large datasets using reporting technologies such as Power BI or Tableau; strong experience using ServiceNow platform is highly desirable.
Excellent stakeholder engagement skills coupled with effective communication abilities enabling you to build strong relationships across business units.
Preferred qualifications include CBCI or Operational Resilience related certification; SQL or data analytics qualifications are advantageous.

What Sets This Company Apart

MUFG stands out as one of the world’s most respected financial institutions with a rich heritage rooted in trustworthiness dependability inclusivity and collaborative spirit. Employees benefit from supportive leadership committed to nurturing talent through comprehensive training programmes flexible working arrangements generous pension contributions plus access to resources designed for personal growth. The company fosters an environment where every voice is valued—ensuring under-represented groups have equal opportunities—and encourages sharing knowledge across teams so everyone feels connected empowered supported throughout their career journey. MUFG’s dedication extends beyond compliance; it actively promotes operational resilience awareness good practice across its global network making it an ideal place for professionals who want their work to have lasting impact on clients colleagues communities alike.

What's Next

If you are ready to make a meaningful difference by joining MUFG’s Operational Resilience Team apply now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

This advert will close 11th October 2026

We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.

MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership.

jobs.title: Retail Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Brand

At J.Jill, we’re redefining what it means to dress and live with ease. As a women-led, Boston-based lifestyle brand with 200+ stores nationwide, we design thoughtful, inspired apparel and accessories that celebrate the totality of all women. We’re entering an exciting chapter of growth — expanding our footprint, reaching new customers, and deepening long-standing relationships. We're seeking bold thinkers and doers to join us. With competitive pay and benefits, a supportive culture, and the chance to make a real impact, this is more than a job, it’s an opportunity to bring our ethos keep it simple, make it matter to life in new and inspiring ways.

Overview

The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Responsibilities

Builds partnerships and operates cross functionally to provide analytical decision support to leaders to increase revenue and profit of various initiatives.
Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.
Understands key performance indicators that drive company results and determines how these metrics track against overall business strategies, goals and objectives.
Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.

Benefits, Tailored for You.

401(k) retirement plan with discretionary match and tuition reimbursement.
Medical, dental, vision, company paid LTD/STD, and generous amount of paid time off.
Generous associate discount; group discounts on auto, pet and homeowner insurance.
Discount Marketplace for travel, consumer products, food, auto buying, etc.
Associate resource groups.

Qualifications

Advanced SQL skills required; experience with statistical predictive analytics tools like R and Python preferred.
Natural analytical curiosity is essential.
Must demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy, a high degree of organization, and have pride in work.
Desire to continuously learn, ability to learn quickly and confidence to ask questions to gain clarity are required.
Strong aptitude with MS Office tools, especially advanced Excel skills.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau) preferred.
Self-motivated with an ability to both work independently as well as collaboratively across functions and business areas.
Ability to not only retrieve and report data, but to also analyze the implications and make recommendations on various key business questions.
Excellent written and verbal communication/follow-up skills (follow up with project partners to ensure accurate and timely completion of deliverables).
Exposure to retail metrics (sales, inventory, UPT, conversion rates, etc.) preferred.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet deadlines.

Education & Experience

3+ years of business experience in an analytical or technical role.
Advanced Excel and SQL skills required.
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling (R, Python) experience preferred.
Reporting and analysis experience in a retail environment preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in business or quantitative discipline (statistics, math) preferred.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

Zebra Technologies is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst
to join our team in Brno. In this role, you will become an integral part of our EMEA Sales Operations organisation, partnering directly with senior sales leadership across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa to turn raw commercial data into timely, high-impact business insights.

You will act as the dedicated strategic business partner for the EMEA Services Sales organisation (representing ~50% of your focus), working closely with regional Sales Directors to steer forecasting, identify performance trends, and evaluate pipeline health across services lines. The remainder of your role will drive operational excellence across the wider team, managing regular reporting (e.g., MBO/KPI frameworks), optimising processes, and leading ad-hoc commercial analytics projects.

This role operates under our standard hybrid policy, requiring 3 days in the office per week alongside 2 days of remote work from home. Our office in Brno is located at Vlněna Office Park.

Responsibilities

Services Revenue Forecasting & Pipeline Modelling: Lead end-to-end forecasting, trend analysis, and performance modelling for EMEA Services sales segments. Support key outlook reports, monitor pipeline health, and identify risks/opportunities ahead of quarter-end.
Commercial Business Partnering: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional Sales Directors and commercial leaders. Translate complex data sets into executive-ready narratives, actionable commentary, and clear commercial recommendations.
Process Modernisation & Automation: Proactively evaluate workflows, standardising and automating regular reporting cadences (MBO/KPI reporting, regional scorecards) to drive reporting efficiency and eliminate manual effort.
Requirements & Analytics Translation: Bridge the gap between commercial strategy and technical teams (IT, Finance, Supply Chain) by converting business needs into scalable reporting and dashboard specifications.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with colleagues across Brno, Germany, the UK, and regional field teams to ensure consistency across hardware, services, and software/automation revenue lines.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
3+ years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations (RevOps), Sales Analytics, or Commercial/FP&A.
3+ years of hands-on expertise in advanced data analysis, building reports, and developing interactive dashboards (Excel expertise is essential; Power BI, Tableau, or CRM analytics tools are a strong plus).
Fluent/Professional English is mandatory (our working language is English across EMEA).
Proven experience partnering directly with Sales Leadership teams (Directors, Regional Heads) within a fast-paced, matrixed multinational environment.
Ability to look beyond data tables and spreadsheets to understand go-to-market dynamics, quota structures, and sales drivers.
Strong written and verbal presentation skills, with the ability to summarise technical/complex data into concise bullet points and executive takeaways.

5 weeks of vacation, 5 sick days and 4 volunteer days paid off.
Multisport card at a reduced price.
Meal contribution.
Monthly contribution 1000 CZK/month in the form of credits on your Benefit plus card with cafeteria system where you can choose from wide range of activities/benefits from Health, Sports, Travel, Wellness, Development, Culture up to company Language courses.
Training and personal development in soft skills and hard skills, access to our internal learning portal and internal career opportunities within Zebra departments.
Annual bonuses based on financial results.
Yearly salary increases according to individual performance.
Employee referral bonus for bringing New Talent to Zebra.
Free beverages and fruit days (coffee, tea, milk available in our kitchenette).
Life & Pension insurance contribution.
New modern and multifunctional workplace at Vlněna Office park in the city centre
Discount at our partners (Banks, HP, Dell, Microsoft Office).

Incentive Compensation

In addition to base pay, Zebra offers this role the opportunity to earn a performance-based annual cash incentive, at a target equal to 10% of base pay, in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.

jobs.description:
Description

Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be responsible to be the single source of truth in terms of data and analysis during and after incidents, and ensure metrics at leadership level is reported accurately.

Key job responsibilities

Real-Time Incident Analytics — Serve as the single source of truth for data and analysis during high-severity incidents, providing actionable insights to guide response decisions and minimize customer impact.
Post-Incident Reporting & Metrics — Deliver accurate, leadership-level metrics and post-incident analysis, ensuring root causes, impact scope, and resolution timelines are clearly documented.
Cross-Functional Data Coordination — Partner with dozens of response teams during incidents to aggregate, validate, and synthesize data from multiple systems, enabling a unified operational picture.
Trend Identification & Proactive Insights — Analyze incident patterns, contact volume spikes, and service disruption data to identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures that reduce future customer impact.

2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Experience working with Tableau
Experience using very large datasets

Job Title: Environmental Project Manager I

Location: Reston, VA

Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

HGL has a position open for an Environmental Project Manager I
to support project work based out of our Reston, VA headquarters. The Environmental Project Manager will manage large-scale, multi-year projects for HGL’s government clients, including the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, along with other federal and state government clients.

Responsibilities/Duties

What You'll Be Doing

Managing and supporting CERCLA-regulated remediation projects and field investigations at hazardous waste sites.
Developing project budgets based on scope and developing project schedules to meet performance and payment milestones.
Directing, managing, and leading project teams to meet project objectives in line with corporate and customer quality expectations.
Communicating effectively with clients, regulators, project team members, field crews, subcontractors, and company management.
Analyzing and interpreting environmental and analytical data.
Managing technical and administrative aspects of project deliverables, including reviewing and authoring technical reports, specifically CERCLA Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Remedial Designs, Remedial Action Work Plans, or similar phases of environmental restoration projects.
Procuring subcontractors, developing cost estimates, and overseeing field teams.
Managing project risks and developing associated mitigation approaches and strategies.
Supporting business development efforts, including leading or supporting proposal efforts.
Supervising project staff.
Traveling to project sites and client offices, as needed, approximately 10% of the time.
Utilizing approved digital and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support technical documentation, data analysis, project communications, and workflow efficiency.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

Minimum 4 years of experience executing and managing EPA, DoD, and/or DOE investigation and remediation projects regulated by CERCLA and/or RCRA.
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or other related environmental field of study.
Strong technical writing, organizational, and oral communication skills required. The successful candidate will show directly relevant experience that demonstrates a history of responsibility, initiative, motivation, and creative problem solving.
Willingness to support technical tasks ranging from fieldwork and field operations; development of specifications; and data management, evaluation, and report preparation.
Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite required.
Knowledge of appropriate methodologies for groundwater, surface water, soil, and sediment sampling at CERCLA and RCRA sites.
Excellent time management and organization skills, including the ability to take on multiple tasks, prioritize, and remain organized to ensure timely and accurate work.
Ability to build consensus among leadership and stakeholders through effective interpersonal communication and relationship building skills.
EPA Superfund experience.
Knowledge of CERCLA process and work phases.
Demonstrated ability to learn and adopt new technologies and digital tools to improve project delivery and operational efficiency.

Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

Master’s degree in a related field.
Experience mentoring and supervising staff.
Current 40-hr OSHA HAZWOPER certification and associated 8-hr OSHA refresher certification.
Professional credentials (e.g., PE, PG and/or PMP).
Experience with Microsoft Project.
Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve technical writing, data analysis, research, visualization, or project delivery efficiency.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS

Ability to lift/move/relocate items up to 50 lbs; Prolonged sitting or standing up to 70% of the time (depending on task); Walking long distances; Repetitive hand motions (typing, tool use, etc.); Ability to see details at close range and at distance; Viewing computer screen for extended periods; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps, graphs, warning indicators, etc.); Driving a company or personal vehicle; Climbing ladders or stairs
Analyzing and synthesizing data; Complex problem solving and decision making; Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations; Writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation; Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities; Communicating effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders; Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

Work Environment Requirements

Must be able to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions (heat, cold, rain, snow, etc.). Must be able to travel approximately 10% per year. May work in environments with loud noises, dust, or hazardous materials. Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when in the field. Potential for occasional longer workdays of up to 12 hours in duration.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule:
Standard 5-day work week. Field schedules may vary based on job requirements and may require longer hours as needed.

Office Type:
In-office position at HGL’s Reston, VA headquarters.

Travel:
Approximately 10%

A favorable pre-hire drug test and physical are required.

All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

This specific role supports a U.S. Federal government contract(s) which require(s) employees engaged on this contract to be U.S. citizens.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY

At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.

Hgl - Who We Are

The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU

It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.

jobs.title: BU Security Manager
jobs.description:
Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.

Din roll

Som BU Security Manager arbetar du i en internationell miljö där avancerade säkerhetshot, komplexa IT-miljöer och affärskritiska projekt är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du har en central roll i att stödja affärsenheten inom säkerhetsområdet och ansvarar för att säkerställa ett strukturerat och riskmedvetet säkerhetsarbete som är integrerat i verksamheten. Rollen innebär att identifiera, analysera och hantera säkerhetsrisker samt att omsätta strategiska säkerhetsmål till praktiska arbetssätt och aktiviteter.

Du fungerar som en rådgivande expert inom säkerhetsskydd och stöttar verksamheten i frågor som rör riskhantering, säkerhetskrav och incidenthantering. Du leder och samordnar säkerhetsarbetet inom affärsenheten, bidrar till att stärka säkerhetsmedvetenheten och är en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa förutsättningar för säkra och välgrundade beslut. Rollen omfattar även deltagande i verksamhetskritiska projekt, säkerhetsplanering kopplat till projektverksamheten, stöd inom resesäkerhet samt medverkan i vår krisledningsgrupp.

Tjänsten är placerad i Huskvarna/Jönköping. Resor förekommer, främst inom Sverige men även internationellt.

Din profil

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du en person med hög integritet, gott omdöme och ett starkt ansvarstagande. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att omsätta komplex information till tydliga rekommendationer. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga. Du bygger förtroendefulla relationer och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt skapa förståelse för säkerhetsrelaterade frågor.

Vi söker dig som har:

Flera års erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsriskhantering, krishantering eller närliggande områden.
Mycket god kunskap om säkerhetsskyddslagen samt praktisk erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetsskyddsfrågor.
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, Polisen eller Försvarsmakten, samt erfarenhet av incidenthantering och/eller incidentutredningar.

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

jobs.description:
Description

Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

Key job responsibilities

Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.

About The Team

The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

1+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Experience working with Tableau
Experience using very large datasets
