new_jobs.title: Project Manager (Data Centers)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Project Manager (Data Centers)
to join us in Houston, TX.
The following locations will also be considered: San Diego, CA, New York, NY, Houston, TX, Portland, OR and Seattle, WA
. This position can be offered remotely.

As demand for AI, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure accelerates, our clients are developing some of the world's largest, most complex, and most power-intensive facilities. In this role, you will help deliver the electrical infrastructure that enables next-generation data center campuses—projects requiring hundreds of megawatts of power and unprecedented levels of planning, engineering, and coordination. You will work across the full project lifecycle, playing a key role in delivering critical infrastructure for some of the industry's most prominent clients.

What makes this opportunity unique is the breadth of collaboration across WSP's global organization. You will work alongside top experts in their field to solve highly complex infrastructure challenges. This multidisciplinary environment provides exposure to the full range of technical and strategic considerations required to successfully develop large-scale data center campuses. You will contribute to the planning and design of substations, transmission interconnections, and site electrical infrastructure while supporting fast-paced projects that demand innovation, technical excellence, and strong collaboration.

If you're energized by large-scale infrastructure projects, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while accelerating your career on some of the most significant power delivery projects being developed today.

Provides technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of critical high-voltage infrastructure for data center projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. Tasks include responsibility for overall performance of distribution system and grid modernization projects of moderate size/complexity and/or local/regional scope. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.

Your Impact

Lead and oversee cross-functional teams delivering power distribution and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and distribution projects.
Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power & energy market.
Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for power delivery projects.
Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in all aspects of distribution design.
Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects.
Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future projects.
Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of experience managing projects in power distribution, transmission & distribution (T&D), or utility engineering environments.
Proven experience delivering feeder, distribution line, or grid modernization projects.
Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in complex utility environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
PMI Certification (PMP or CAPM).

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $102,200 - $182,200

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Expected Salary (Colorado only): $95,000 - $159,000

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position within the state of Colorado, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

new_jobs.description:
Project Manager – Business Consultant with SAP Background

Location: Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager / Business Consultant with SAP background to join our team. At EY, you’ll have a chance to build your career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too.

As a part of our global Business Transformation Delivery and Execution team, you will participate in international projects, leading projects and programs for our global market clients. You will be involved in working on challenging assignments, assisting our client's trough they transformation and organization change journeys. You will also be part of team creating industry leading solutions in widely understood project management services.

Your Key Responsibilities

You will support our clients in the business and organizational transformation journey, actively becoming a trusted advisor in PM subject matters for both clients and EY colleagues.
You will provide consultation and recommendations based on client’s requirement and develop relationships with team members across all EY practises to serve client needs. You will work with various teams to ensure that client’s requirement, budget and milestones for projects are met.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong planning and organizing skills, with the ability to see the big picture as well as focus on details and ensure errorless delivery.
Excellent professional communication skills, with the ability to approach senior stakeholders using an appropriate level of detail, terminology, and fit-for-purpose communication.
Ability to work in a continuously changing environment, being proactive with a can-do attitude, looking for solutions and opportunities.
Strong project management skills, including experience with agile methods.

To qualify for the role, you must have

A minimum of 3 years of experience in large-scale project or program implementation within distributed multicultural environments.
High-level knowledge of SAP ERP and/or SAP S/4HANA.

Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Summary

Avetta is seeking a highly skilled Localization Technical Program Manager
to set technical direction and serve as an embedded partner across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing. You will make Avetta’s products globally ready by connecting product engineering, localization technology, and release delivery. This hands-on leadership role combines internationalization (i18n) engineering, localization-systems ownership, and technical program leadership to ensure Avetta’s products are designed for global markets and its localization workflows are reliable, scalable, and integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You will lead technical delivery across product i18n and the localization technology ecosystem, from early design through release. This includes ownership of Phrase/TMS configuration, APIs and integrations, Avetta’s central platform for AI-enabled translation, workflow automation, release readiness, and technical enablement for the localization team. You will establish standards, guide implementation, and help resolve complex technical and process issues. The role requires a highly specialized combination of deep i18n knowledge and hands-on localization systems expertise. Targeted i18n and localization quality metrics may be used to identify issues and guide improvements, but analytics and reporting are not the primary focus of the role.

If residing within commutable distance to one of our offices, a hybrid schedule would be required (3 days in office, 2 days work from home). Candidates within commutable distance are preferred, but those outside of an office area may be considered on a remote basis.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Design and implement i18n solutions within the software development lifecycle, including string externalization, resource-file architecture, Unicode and encoding support, and scalable patterns for locale-aware product behavior.
Define and review locale behavior across products, including pluralization, grammatical variants, date, time, number, and currency formats, time zones, sorting, and other regional conventions.

Partner with Localization Testing to support pseudo-localization, functional validation, defect triage, and release readiness.
Own and administer Phrase or a comparable Translation Management System (TMS), including project and workflow configuration, translation memories, termbases, quality settings, permissions, automation, and lifecycle governance.
Design, maintain, and troubleshoot TMS/API workflows and integrations with product repositories, content systems, and delivery pipelines. Serve as the technical escalation point for localization systems and process issues.

Identify and support opportunities to streamline and automate localization workflows, including translation, review, and delivery. Lead automation of the localization defect and bug-triage process, applying AI where appropriate across these workflows.
Lead localization technical programs from planning through release, managing scope, dependencies, risks, priorities, and regional requirements while coordinating Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing.
Embed localization requirements and best practices early in product discovery, design, and development. Provide hands-on guidance during implementation and respond quickly to release critical issues.
Help localization team members resolve technical and process issues; create practical documentation and enablement. Pull and interpret targeted i18n, localization quality, or workflow-health metrics when needed to diagnose trends and guide improvements.

Ideal Education, Training, And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in internationalization engineering, localization engineering, localization technology, or a closely related discipline.
Fluency in a second language is preferred. In addition to English, preferred languages may include, but are not limited to, German, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, or other languages that support global collaboration and cross-cultural communication.
Deep knowledge of i18n fundamentals, including string externalization, locale-aware behavior, pluralization, date/number/currency formatting, RTL support, Unicode, and placeholder or markup protection.
Hands-on expertise configuring and administering Phrase or comparable TMS, including translation memories, termbases, workflow automation, quality controls, permissions, and troubleshooting.

Experience designing AI-enabled products and workflows, including LLM and Machine Translation integrations, prompt design, API-based orchestration, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop quality controls.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Within Data Center Engineering, the Security Solutions team is the newest generations of Security technologies from concept to production readiness in our data centers. Lead end-to-end planning and execution of AI for Chip Design initiatives, ensuring timely, on-scope, and scalable delivery

Operationalize the evaluation of both internal and external AI tools, drive their availability and adoption by collaborating with hardware teams, providing guidance, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement
Act as a product and program interface between silicon design teams, internal AI platform teams, and third-party partners, helping prioritize requirements and translate user needs into actionable roadmaps
Establish and monitor key program metrics to measure execution success, identify bottlenecks, and ensure delivery meets quality, performance, and scalability targets
Serve as the central point of communication for all collaborators, providing clear status updates and insights into dependencies.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with proven experience leading complex, multi-functional technical programs in AI, silicon, or infrastructure
10+ years of technical program management spanning AI and ASIC chip design
Strong understanding of RTL design, simulation, and formal verification, as well as software engineering fundamentals, system architecture, and scalable infrastructure
Hands-on experience building, deploying, integrating, or enabling AI agents, LLM-powered systems, or AI productivity tools in real-world engineering workflows
Proven ability to collaborate deeply with engineering teams and influence technical decisions, architecture, prioritization, and trade-offs
Experience driving programs from concept through production, including planning, execution, risk management, team alignment, and delivery at scale

Hands-on experience in hardware or silicon development environments, understanding RTL, verification, and pre-silicon workflows
Experience evaluating, integrating, or deploying third-party tools into enterprise engineering environments

In this role, you will help deliver the electrical infrastructure that enables next-generation data center campuses—projects requiring hundreds of megawatts of power and unprecedented levels of planning, engineering, and coordination. If you're energized by large-scale infrastructure projects, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while accelerating your career on some of the most significant power delivery projects being developed today.

Provides technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of critical high-voltage infrastructure for data center projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, MADS
new_jobs.description:
Description

Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About The Team

The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations.

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

new_jobs.title: Localization Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Summary

Avetta is seeking a highly skilled Localization Technical Program Manager
to set technical direction and serve as an embedded partner across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing. You will make Avetta’s products globally ready by connecting product engineering, localization technology, and release delivery. This hands-on leadership role combines internationalization (i18n) engineering, localization-systems ownership, and technical program leadership to ensure Avetta’s products are designed for global markets and its localization workflows are reliable, scalable, and integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You will lead technical delivery across product i18n and the localization technology ecosystem, from early design through release. This includes ownership of Phrase/TMS configuration, APIs and integrations, Avetta’s central platform for AI-enabled translation, workflow automation, release readiness, and technical enablement for the localization team. You will establish standards, guide implementation, and help resolve complex technical and process issues. The role requires a highly specialized combination of deep i18n knowledge and hands-on localization systems expertise. Targeted i18n and localization quality metrics may be used to identify issues and guide improvements, but analytics and reporting are not the primary focus of the role.

If residing within commutable distance to one of our offices, a hybrid schedule would be required (3 days in office, 2 days work from home). Candidates within commutable distance are preferred, but those outside of an office area may be considered on a remote basis.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Design and implement i18n solutions within the software development lifecycle, including string externalization, resource-file architecture, Unicode and encoding support, and scalable patterns for locale-aware product behavior.
Define and review locale behavior across products, including pluralization, grammatical variants, date, time, number, and currency formats, time zones, sorting, and other regional conventions.
Ensure product readiness for right-to-left (RTL) languages and protect variables, placeholders, markups, and other non-translatable elements throughout content and translation workflows.
Partner with Localization Testing to support pseudo-localization, functional validation, defect triage, and release readiness.
Own and administer Phrase or a comparable Translation Management System (TMS), including project and workflow configuration, translation memories, termbases, quality settings, permissions, automation, and lifecycle governance.
Design, maintain, and troubleshoot TMS/API workflows and integrations with product repositories, content systems, and delivery pipelines. Serve as the technical escalation point for localization systems and process issues.
Serve as the technical product owner for Avetta's central platform for AI-enabled translation, defining its roadmap, architecture, capabilities, and integration strategy across TMS and localization workflows. Translate localization needs into technical requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions in partnership with Product and Engineering.
Identify and support opportunities to streamline and automate localization workflows, including translation, review, and delivery. Lead automation of the localization defect and bug-triage process, applying AI where appropriate across these workflows.
Lead localization technical programs from planning through release, managing scope, dependencies, risks, priorities, and regional requirements while coordinating Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing.
Embed localization requirements and best practices early in product discovery, design, and development. Provide hands-on guidance during implementation and respond quickly to release critical issues.
Help localization team members resolve technical and process issues; create practical documentation and enablement. Pull and interpret targeted i18n, localization quality, or workflow-health metrics when needed to diagnose trends and guide improvements.

Ideal Education, Training, And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in internationalization engineering, localization engineering, localization technology, or a closely related discipline.
Fluency in a second language is preferred. In addition to English, preferred languages may include, but are not limited to, German, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, or other languages that support global collaboration and cross-cultural communication.
Deep knowledge of i18n fundamentals, including string externalization, locale-aware behavior, pluralization, date/number/currency formatting, RTL support, Unicode, and placeholder or markup protection.
Hands-on expertise configuring and administering Phrase or comparable TMS, including translation memories, termbases, workflow automation, quality controls, permissions, and troubleshooting.
Experience building or supporting localization APIs and integrations; familiarity with formats and technologies such as JSON, XML, XLIFF, ICU MessageFormat, REST APIs, webhooks, source control, and CI/CD is strongly preferred.
Experience designing AI-enabled products and workflows, including LLM and Machine Translation integrations, prompt design, API-based orchestration, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop quality controls.
Strong technical program management, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience working in Agile software development and release environments across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, and testing teams.
Ability to provide timely support during releases and maintain substantial working hours overlap with Avetta's core Product and Engineering teams. Experience using i18n or localization quality metrics is helpful; dashboarding or data-visualization expertise is not required.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to prototype solutions, develop workflow automations, document technical designs, or accelerate implementation is strongly preferred. Ability to contribute through APIs or scripting is beneficial; production software development is not required.

new_jobs.description:

CarMax, the way your career should be!

Senior Program Manager

CarMax Auto Finance, Kennesaw, GA

Role Anchor:
Owns complex, ambiguous, cross-functional business and technology initiatives by framing problems, shaping practical solution paths, aligning business and Technology partners, and driving work through implementation and adoption.

About This Job

The Senior Program Manager at CarMax Auto Finance is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives that require strong problem-solving, operational understanding, and technology fluency. This role partners with business leaders, Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Risk, Learning, Communications, and other stakeholders to understand business problems, evaluate solution options, and drive work from discovery through implementation.

This role goes beyond coordinating work or managing project plans. The Senior Program Manager takes ownership of ambiguous problems, asks effective questions, examines how processes and systems work together, and helps teams identify practical paths forward. The role evaluates whether a need may be addressed through process redesign, automation, reporting or data improvements, AI-enabled capabilities, technology enhancements, or a combination of solutions.

The Senior Program Manager develops a strong understanding of CAF processes, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, and operational workflows. While not responsible for detailed requirements or technical design, this role brings enough business and technical fluency to shape solution options, evaluate tradeoffs, recognize cross-functional impacts, and connect business needs with Technology capabilities.

What You Will Do – Essential Responsibilities

Own complex, ambiguous cross-functional initiatives by clarifying the business problem, intended outcomes, customer and associate impacts, operational context, and key constraints. Lead early problem-framing and solution-shaping by gathering facts, asking thoughtful questions, challenging assumptions, and engaging the right business, Product, Technology, and analytical partners. Develop a working understanding of current processes, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, and handoffs to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement. Evaluate practical solution options across process redesign, workflow automation, reporting and data improvements, configurable technology, integrations, AI-enabled capabilities, and broader operational change. Facilitate decision-making across stakeholders by clarifying tradeoffs, operational impacts, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and recommendations needed to move work forward. Connect work across multiple functions, products, systems, and Technology teams to ensure decisions, sequencing, dependencies, and implementation plans support a cohesive end-to-end solution. Lead implementation and operational readiness by coordinating communications, training, controls, documentation, adoption, support, transition needs, and early post-launch issue resolution. Create clear executive-level materials and governance updates including decision summaries, solution recommendations, roadmaps, risks, status updates, and measurable success outcomes.

Purpose of the Role

The Senior Program Manager helps CAF solve complex business problems that require coordination and solution shaping across business and Technology teams. This role ensures the problem is sufficiently understood, the appropriate partners are engaged, practical solution options are evaluated, and work progresses from ambiguity to implementation and adoption.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, outcome-oriented, and comfortable operating with limited direction. They understand how processes, people, systems, data, integrations, and controls work together and can connect business needs with technology-enabled opportunities. They use structured thinking, operational knowledge, and technical fluency to identify options, surface tradeoffs, and guide teams toward practical, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

The Senior Program Manager Typically Leads Work Involving

Multiple business functions, products, or Technology platforms
High ambiguity or material organizational impact
Significant regulatory, financial, customer, operational, or reputational risk
Complex sequencing and resource conflicts
Multiple senior-level decision makers
CAF-wide or enterprise impact
Executive governance and visibility
Limited precedent or an undefined delivery path
A need to establish the program structure and governance model

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, program management, technology, operations, finance, analytics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional programs, business initiatives, technology-enabled change, process improvement, or transformation efforts.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems, establish clarity, evaluate alternatives, synthesize complex information, and move work forward with limited direction.
Experience facilitating discovery, solution-shaping, and decision-making discussions across business, Product, Technology, Operations, and control partners.
Strong understanding of business processes, operational workflows, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, technology constraints, and the operational effects of technology changes.
Ability to evaluate solution options involving process redesign, automation, reporting, data, integrations, configurable platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, or technology enhancements while identifying risks, dependencies, cross-functional impacts, and implementation considerations.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, align stakeholders across functions and organizational levels, manage competing priorities, and facilitate decisions involving business value, feasibility, risk, resources, and timing.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing executive summaries, decision materials, solution recommendations, roadmaps, stakeholder communications, and implementation/adoption materials.
Preferred experience with Agile, Waterfall, hybrid delivery approaches, or technology-delivery practices; consumer finance, auto finance, financial services, operations, technology, analytics, risk, or process-improvement environments.

CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent, and high-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 250 locations nationwide.

Our amazing team of more than 30,000 associates works together to deliver iconic experiences for internal and external customers. Continuous Monitoring, Automation & Innovation

Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

The Senior IT Project Manager is a seasoned project delivery leader responsible for successfully managing complex, enterprise-wide technology initiatives from inception through completion. This role provides end-to-end ownership of project execution, including strategic planning, stakeholder engagement, risk and issue management, governance oversight, budget and schedule control, and transparent communication of project progress, decisions, and outcomes. Partnering closely with Portfolio Managers, executive sponsors, Domain Leads, Enterprise Architects, technical teams, and business stakeholders, the Senior IT Project Manager translates business objectives into actionable project roadmaps and drives delivery excellence. By balancing technical, operational, and business priorities, this individual ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards while achieving measurable business value and organizational objectives.

What The Role Offers

Manage complex IT projects from initiation through deployment and closure, ensuring delivery within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
Translate sponsor objectives, project requirements, and business needs into clear project charters, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and execution approaches.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and delivery partners to drive execution, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment with project objectives and expected business outcomes.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, including workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource assumptions, financial tracking, and delivery constraints.
Apply PMO methodology and Project Navigator practices to ensure required documentation, approvals, decision logs, change controls, and governance artifacts are complete and current.
Support benefits definition and tracking by partnering with requestors and sponsors to clarify expected outcomes, success measures, and business value for assigned projects.
Prepare clear, decision-oriented reporting for sponsors, Portfolio Managers, project governance forums, and stakeholders, highlighting delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and required actions.
Proactively identify risks and issues, develop mitigation plans, escalate appropriately, and drive timely resolution across business and technical teams.
Serve as the primary project delivery contact for sponsors, Domain Leads, technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and PMO leadership.
Communicate complex project information in a concise, audience-appropriate manner, ensuring stakeholders understand progress, risks, decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
Lead without direct authority by creating accountability, building trust, and enabling collaboration across cross-functional project teams.
Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned, identifying process gaps, and supporting PMO standards, templates, reporting practices, and tool adoption.

What You Need To Succeed

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience considered.
6+ years of progressive project management experience, preferably managing complex, cross-functional IT projects in a matrixed enterprise environment.
Proven ability to deliver complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
Strong knowledge of project lifecycle management, governance, change control, risk and issue management, financial tracking, project reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Well-versed in Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid delivery approaches.
PMP certification preferred; PMI-ACP, ITIL, PRINCE2, or other relevant certifications considered an asset.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, project planning tools, PPM/reporting platforms, and collaboration technologies.
Interest in AI learning and practical application of AI-enabled tools to improve planning, reporting, risk visibility, project controls, and delivery outcomes.

ONE LAST THING

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will lead complex, enterprise-wide technology initiatives from strategy through successful delivery, partnering with executive sponsors, technical teams, and business leaders to drive impactful outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for a collaborative and results-driven project management professional to oversee planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and execution across high-visibility projects. You'll play a key role in translating business objectives into actionable roadmaps, leading cross-functional teams, championing continuous improvement, and leveraging modern delivery practices, including Agile, Waterfall, and emerging AI-enabled tools, to deliver measurable business value and lasting organizational impact.

FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

The Sr. Cybersecurity Analyst – Leveraging AI for Automation of Data Pipelines and BI. Develops and operates scalable security data, analytics, and reporting capabilities that provide a centralized view of risk across FreeWheel and Comcast. This role integrates data from cloud security, application security, asset management, AI Security, vulnerability management, and other security domains into trusted data pipelines, dashboards, and compliance reporting. The analyst works independently and across multiple engineering and security teams to define actionable severity and priority models, establish remediation service-level agreements, improve data quality, and drive timely risk reduction.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Designing, building, and maintaining automated security data pipelines, ETL processes, data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that consolidate information from multiple teams and data sources.
Administering, optimizing, and supporting Splunk Enterprise, including SmartStore, and Splunk Enterprise Security capabilities used for security analytics, reporting, and operational visibility.
Developing centralized security reporting across cloud security, application security, asset management, artificial intelligence, vulnerability management, compliance, and related security domains.
Partnering with security, engineering, product, infrastructure, governance, risk, and compliance teams to define reporting requirements, authoritative data sources, metrics, and data-quality controls.
Creating clear executive, operational, and compliance dashboards that translate complex security data into actionable insights, trends, risks, and remediation priorities.
Defining and evolving severity and priority models, remediation service-level agreements, exception criteria, and escalation paths for different types of findings and vulnerabilities.
Monitoring remediation performance and driving adherence to agreed service-level agreements across engineering groups through transparent metrics, stakeholder engagement, and follow-through.
Integrating Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) and related asset inventory data to improve asset coverage, ownership, exposure visibility, and risk prioritization.
Automating recurring compliance reporting and evidence collection while maintaining traceability, accuracy, appropriate access controls, and audit readiness.
Evaluating data gaps, duplicate or conflicting records, pipeline failures, and reporting inconsistencies; coordinating corrective actions with source-system owners.
Supporting security analytics and reporting for public cloud environments, with an emphasis on AWS services, security telemetry, asset context, and control status.
Communicating recommendations, tradeoffs, dependencies, and risk clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders across FreeWheel and Comcast.
Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Experience with business intelligence, security reporting, dashboards, ETL, data integration, and data pipeline technologies.
Hands-on experience with Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Enterprise Security; experience with Splunk SmartStore is preferred in addition to other similar technologies.
Proven experience with using AI tools both for development and other security workflows.
Experience integrating data from multiple teams and source systems into a centralized security reporting or analytics platform.
Experience with security compliance reporting, control evidence, metrics, and audit-support processes.
Experience with CAASM, attack surface management, asset inventory, exposure management, or comparable security data platforms.
Demonstrated ability to define severity and priority models and remediation service-level agreements, and to influence engineering teams to meet them.
Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, including vulnerabilities, findings, controls, asset ownership, risk, and remediation workflows.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders across FreeWheel and Comcast.

Job Title: Environmental Project Manager I

Location: Reston, VA

Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

HGL has a position open for an Environmental Project Manager I
to support project work based out of our Reston, VA headquarters. The Environmental Project Manager will manage large-scale, multi-year projects for HGL’s government clients, including the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, along with other federal and state government clients.

Responsibilities/Duties

What You'll Be Doing

Managing and supporting CERCLA-regulated remediation projects and field investigations at hazardous waste sites.
Developing project budgets based on scope and developing project schedules to meet performance and payment milestones.
Directing, managing, and leading project teams to meet project objectives in line with corporate and customer quality expectations.
Communicating effectively with clients, regulators, project team members, field crews, subcontractors, and company management.
Analyzing and interpreting environmental and analytical data.
Managing technical and administrative aspects of project deliverables, including reviewing and authoring technical reports, specifically CERCLA Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Remedial Designs, Remedial Action Work Plans, or similar phases of environmental restoration projects.
Procuring subcontractors, developing cost estimates, and overseeing field teams.
Managing project risks and developing associated mitigation approaches and strategies.
Supporting business development efforts, including leading or supporting proposal efforts.
Supervising project staff.
Traveling to project sites and client offices, as needed, approximately 10% of the time.
Utilizing approved digital and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support technical documentation, data analysis, project communications, and workflow efficiency.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

Minimum 4 years of experience executing and managing EPA, DoD, and/or DOE investigation and remediation projects regulated by CERCLA and/or RCRA.
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or other related environmental field of study.
Strong technical writing, organizational, and oral communication skills required. The successful candidate will show directly relevant experience that demonstrates a history of responsibility, initiative, motivation, and creative problem solving.
Willingness to support technical tasks ranging from fieldwork and field operations; development of specifications; and data management, evaluation, and report preparation.
Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite required.
Knowledge of appropriate methodologies for groundwater, surface water, soil, and sediment sampling at CERCLA and RCRA sites.
Excellent time management and organization skills, including the ability to take on multiple tasks, prioritize, and remain organized to ensure timely and accurate work.
Ability to build consensus among leadership and stakeholders through effective interpersonal communication and relationship building skills.
EPA Superfund experience.
Knowledge of CERCLA process and work phases.
Demonstrated ability to learn and adopt new technologies and digital tools to improve project delivery and operational efficiency.

Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

Master’s degree in a related field.
Experience mentoring and supervising staff.
Current 40-hr OSHA HAZWOPER certification and associated 8-hr OSHA refresher certification.
Professional credentials (e.g., PE, PG and/or PMP).
Experience with Microsoft Project.
Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve technical writing, data analysis, research, visualization, or project delivery efficiency.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS

Ability to lift/move/relocate items up to 50 lbs; Prolonged sitting or standing up to 70% of the time (depending on task); Walking long distances; Repetitive hand motions (typing, tool use, etc.); Ability to see details at close range and at distance; Viewing computer screen for extended periods; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps, graphs, warning indicators, etc.); Driving a company or personal vehicle; Climbing ladders or stairs
Analyzing and synthesizing data; Complex problem solving and decision making; Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations; Writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation; Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities; Communicating effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders; Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

Work Environment Requirements

Must be able to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions (heat, cold, rain, snow, etc.). Must be able to travel approximately 10% per year. May work in environments with loud noises, dust, or hazardous materials. Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when in the field. Potential for occasional longer workdays of up to 12 hours in duration.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule:
Standard 5-day work week. Field schedules may vary based on job requirements and may require longer hours as needed.

Office Type:
In-office position at HGL’s Reston, VA headquarters.

Travel:
Approximately 10%

A favorable pre-hire drug test and physical are required.

All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

This specific role supports a U.S. Federal government contract(s) which require(s) employees engaged on this contract to be U.S. citizens.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY

At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.

Hgl - Who We Are

The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU

It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected category. Some positions may require U.S. citizenship. Applicants who wish to request a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process should contact Human Resources directly at 703-478-5186.

EEO notices: US Equal Opportunity Employment Poster , US Equal Opportunity Supplemental Poster , Know Your Rights , and Pay Transparency Notice .

A full list of benefits is available at www.hgl.com/careers/ .

Digital & AI Proficiency:
HGL encourages the responsible use of approved AI-enabled and digital technologies to improve productivity, technical quality, decision-making, and project delivery. Candidates who demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and experience leveraging emerging technologies are highly valued.

If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

new_jobs.title: BU Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.

Din roll

Som BU Security Manager arbetar du i en internationell miljö där avancerade säkerhetshot, komplexa IT-miljöer och affärskritiska projekt är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du har en central roll i att stödja affärsenheten inom säkerhetsområdet och ansvarar för att säkerställa ett strukturerat och riskmedvetet säkerhetsarbete som är integrerat i verksamheten. Rollen innebär att identifiera, analysera och hantera säkerhetsrisker samt att omsätta strategiska säkerhetsmål till praktiska arbetssätt och aktiviteter.

Du fungerar som en rådgivande expert inom säkerhetsskydd och stöttar verksamheten i frågor som rör riskhantering, säkerhetskrav och incidenthantering. Du leder och samordnar säkerhetsarbetet inom affärsenheten, bidrar till att stärka säkerhetsmedvetenheten och är en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa förutsättningar för säkra och välgrundade beslut. Rollen omfattar även deltagande i verksamhetskritiska projekt, säkerhetsplanering kopplat till projektverksamheten, stöd inom resesäkerhet samt medverkan i vår krisledningsgrupp.

Tjänsten är placerad i Huskvarna/Jönköping. Resor förekommer, främst inom Sverige men även internationellt.

Din profil

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du en person med hög integritet, gott omdöme och ett starkt ansvarstagande. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att omsätta komplex information till tydliga rekommendationer. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga. Du bygger förtroendefulla relationer och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt skapa förståelse för säkerhetsrelaterade frågor.

Vi söker dig som har:

Flera års erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsriskhantering, krishantering eller närliggande områden.
Mycket god kunskap om säkerhetsskyddslagen samt praktisk erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetsskyddsfrågor.
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, Polisen eller Försvarsmakten, samt erfarenhet av incidenthantering och/eller incidentutredningar.

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

Key job responsibilities

Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.

About The Team

The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Experience working with Tableau
Experience using very large datasets

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Trailhead

Trailhead is Salesforce's free online learning platform and the front door to the Salesforce ecosystem. It empowers anyone to build in-demand skills across AI, Agentforce, CRM, data, and business fundamentals, and helps organizations re-skill their workforce for the agentic era. Today, Trailhead is also an AI-powered learning experience, with personalized pathways and the Trailhead Learning Agent guiding learners every step of the way.

The Trailhead Content team generates ideas, writes and edits content, develops hands-on challenges, and publishes and maintains the learning content that makes all of this possible. We believe content should be accessible, educational, relevant, and enjoyable. Right now, we're building some of the most important learning content in the Salesforce ecosystem. This is your chance to be part of it.

Role Description

As Senior Data Analyst
, you are a senior lead and expert on the team across three connected facets of Trailhead measurement: content analytics and performance
(the Content Intelligence Engine — catalog health, portfolio performance, journey tracking), learner satisfaction and feedback
(structured survey data — CSAT, confidence gain, qualitative themes), and business impact
(whether Trailhead engagement moves Pipeline Generation, Deal Velocity & Win Rate, and Product Adoption). You build the semantic models, data pipelines, and predictive frameworks that turn structured and unstructured signals into decisions — for content owners, executives, and increasingly, AI agents.

Your Impact

Content analytics and performance: Own the Content Intelligence Engine's core metrics and portfolio views (catalog-level completions, L1 product performance, content health vs. performance, journey drop-off) and lead its evolution from MVP through fast-follows and V2 capability.
Learner satisfaction and feedback: Design how unstructured/qualitative learner feedback (open-text survey responses, confidence pre/post scores) is captured, structured, and made analyzable at catalog scale — building the pipeline from raw survey response to reportable CSAT/confidence-gain metrics and automated qualitative theme surfacing for content owners.
Business impact: Own cohort design and methodology (propensity/segment matching) connecting Trailhead engagement signals (TBIDs, badges, Agentblazer status) to commercial outcomes (NNAOV, Win Rate Lift, Time-to-Close, Account Penetration), with defensible bias controls, not just directional correlation.
Architect and own a living semantic model of content performance spanning all three facets — shared metric and cohort definitions that persist and adapt as the Trailhead catalog, survey infrastructure, and AI tooling evolve, rather than one-off analyses that go stale.
Structure both structured (engagement, business) and unstructured (survey/qualitative) data to be agent-queryable — usable by AI layers to reason directly over content quality, learner sentiment, and business outcome questions, not just populate a static dashboard.
Own the logic and definitions that connect learner identity data to business/sales records, content completions to sales opportunities, and survey responses to the specific content they reference
Lead the platform strategy for dashboards and models — keeping pace with Salesforce's evolving analytics and approved AI tooling — and lead the build of the underlying semantic model as our platform evolves.
Translate findings across all three facets into a single, clear narrative for content owners, Trailhead leadership, Marketing, Product, Sales and Customer Success leadership — distinguishing high-confidence findings from directional ones.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years in data analytics or data science, spanning both structured (SQL/engagement/CRM) and unstructured (qualitative/text/survey) data analysis — this is a genuinely three-sided role, not a single-discipline one.
Comfort applying data science methods (cohort/propensity matching, predictive modeling, causal inference) to answer "does this actually work" questions, not just descriptive reporting.
Advanced SQL experience querying large-scale cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake), including learner activity data and sales/CRM data (opportunities, order line items, contracts).
Experience structuring and analyzing unstructured/qualitative data — open-text survey responses, sentiment/theme extraction — turning free text into reportable, comparable signal.
Working knowledge of cohort/propensity-matching methodology for business impact analysis.
Expert Tableau dashboard-building, with strong data visualization and design sense; hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to build, query, and maintain dashboards and models.
Executive-ready storytelling across content performance, learner sentiment, and commercial impact narratives.
Advanced English

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, AI-driven analytics, or NLP/text-analytics workflows.
Python for cohort modeling or qualitative theme extraction.
Direct experience with Trailhead
Tableau Certified (Desktop Specialist or Certified Data Analyst).
Familiarity with agentic or AI-native BI tooling (e.g. Hex) or notebook-based visualization (e.g. Python + Plotly/Streamlit) as complements to Tableau.
Openness to adopting new dashboard and BI tooling as it emerges.

What We Look For In Every Hire

Learner-first mindset: You design everything with the Trailblazer in mind, not just internal stakeholder requirements.
Clear communicator: Your writing and conversations are direct, jargon-free, and respectful of people's time.
Collaborative by default: You seek out other perspectives, share your work early, and give feedback that helps.
High ownership: You are accountable for your work, proactive about blockers, and remain calm under pressure.
Curious about AI and technology: You actively explore how emerging tools can improve what we build for learners.

NOTE
: By applying to the Sr Data Analyst posting recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring these roles will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.

Benefits & Perks

Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead.com
Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership
Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community
For more details, visit https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/

In school, or graduated within the past 12 months? Please visit
FutureForce
for opportunities.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Business Strategy and Operations Program Manager, you will be a pivotal member of our enablement team, dedicated to removing friction and minimizing administrative burden for our Data Center Operations (DCOps) field teams. Your mission is to provide the operational clarity and process support necessary for our field teams to maintain focus on delivering operational excellence. Your responsibilities will include streamlining the OKR process, simplifying the Rhythm of Business (RoB), and executing a two-way communication strategy that ensures field challenges are heard and addressed by leadership. You will require a service-oriented mindset, focused on empowering our technical teams to work effectively by reducing the complexity and confusion that often accompany large-scale operations.

From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them.
